Comments (English): [ It's so convenient and performs great. ] || ---------------- || A mini dishwasher that I've been waiting for a long time. I've been using a large dishwasher with a double shelf, but it's so convenient to replace it with a mini. It's too big for an 8-person household for two people. I wash dishes without oil by hand, and I use a dishwasher for oily dishes. After searching carefully for a small-capacity dishwasher, this Samsung product seemed the most suitable. It was worth putting it in my shopping cart for a long time and waiting for the gold box to come out. It was worth comparing it carefully and waiting for a long time. When I tried the product, it was convenient and excellent with the functions I expected. Of course, it was perfect for washing. The automatic door opens smoothly, and the drying progressed to the point where there were only a few water droplets. It's a one-compartment mini dishwasher, but the capacity is not small. It secretly holds a lot of contents. I was surprised. It's really spacious for a family of two. The kitchen became neater after reducing the interval from five days to two days. Even for a household with many family members, if you think about using it once a day, unless you have a huge family, I think this capacity dishwasher is more than enough. I have a small family, so I don't have a lot of dishes to wash, so I wash them once every two days. I think the dishwasher is better for oily dishes. Especially in the cold winter, when you dissolve detergent in oily dishes and rinse them, a lot of hot water is consumed. No matter how well you wash them, they are slippery and uncomfortable. However, the dishwasher is much more economical because the machine heats the water itself and washes them. When I compared the hot water gas bill and the dishwasher electricity bill, it was much more economical for me to use the dishwasher. Needless to say, the dishwasher is more efficient in terms of water consumption. As a dishwasher enthusiast, my second dishwasher is a Samsung dishwasher. My first child is now eating baby food and washes dishes all day. If I turn my back even a little while washing dishes, he starts crying right away. I had to wash dishes in a hurry or carry the baby while washing dishes, but since I didn't have this, I can play with the baby more and I love this. I don't have a second child yet, but I was thinking of buying a bottle washer even if I had a second child, and this small one was around 300,000 won. Instead of buying that, I bought this product that can also wash my first child's dishes, and I think it was a hundred, thousand times better. The most important thing is that it can be used to wash bottles when the baby is newborn! The dishes are really well washed in the dishwasher, but I wondered if the bottles would be washed. My child has stopped taking formula milk, so I put rice paste in it and rubbed it. The sticky stuff stayed on the walls! After the basic standard wash, the foreign substances were cleaned well without stickiness! I think powdered milk or milk oil will also be cleaned well. 1-2 nipple screws can be cleaned well even if placed on a wall stand, but since various baby products such as nipples are light and can fly around, it is better to buy a small cleaning net(?)! I bought this and am using it well ~ I uploaded Before / After from the left, so take a look ~ Oh, and some people said they received samples of detergent when installing, but I didn't. Anyway, I ordered detergent that can be used to wash bottles in advance because I was going to wash it with my baby. When I asked, they said it is different for each store. It is not made by Samsung itself, but is sponsored by some stores to sell their products, so it is different for each store. That is a little. regrettable. Anyway, it is easy to operate and the noise is quieter than expected, so I can put the baby to sleep and turn it on! I wake up to the sound of the microwave running, but the dishwasher doesn't and I sleep well (it makes less noise~). On the contrary, the sound of the water lapping is really nice. It sounds like the sound of a washing machine, but the noise is quieter than that of a washing machine. Seriously, why did I only buy this now? If you've made up your mind, use it as soon as possible. Your quality of life will change. ------------------ As of 5 weeks ago-------------------- I'm still using it very, very well. If the amount is small or it's not too dirty, I spin it quickly, and the last picture is really good at spinning. There was one time when I spun it once but it didn't wash. You have to be careful that small objects like chopsticks don't fall underneath! One of the chopsticks fell out, so the fan that rotates the water stream underneath didn't spin, so it didn't clean. I put the chopstick back in and spun it, and it cleaned well. Most of the time, it cleans well, but when the rice paste gets old and hard, I spin it quickly again ~ I'm going to write it again based on what my friends are curious about. Now that I'm used to it, I stack it on top of the dishes, and my friend asked me if it was okay to stack it like this. For example, if you stack rice bowls diagonally, the water stream goes in between, so it cleans even if you stack several of them. However, if you stack the rice bowls straight in a row, the space where the water stream doesn't go in won't be cleaned, and only the visible part will be cleaned. Is that easy to understand? Don't stack them completely straight, but think of them as slightly spaced out, so that the water stream goes in between and cleans well. Also, I wondered if I really needed to use dishwasher rinse, but I definitely bought it! This is the difference in effect between spraying a coating spray on the windshield of a car and not spraying it. If you don't spray a coating spray, water droplets will form, right? There are water droplets forming and pooling in the rice bowl as well. The rinse coats the dishes, so if you spray a coating spray on your car, it won't form and it will drip down cleanly. Just like that, there is less water left in the rice bowl and it dries quickly. It also has less water stains ~~ I'm so happy to run the dishwasher and clean the sink. Comments (English): Jin-ja-! I love it! First of all, the reason for purchasing it was that when my husband and I lived together, I thought a dishwasher was a luxury, but those who have raised babies know that it would be nice to have someone who only washes bottles, right? My first child is now eating baby food and washes dishes all day. If I turn my back even a little while washing dishes, he starts crying right away. I had to wash dishes in a hurry or carry the baby while washing dishes, but since I didn't have this, I can play with the baby more and I love this. I don't have a second child yet, but I was thinking of buying a bottle washer even if I had a second child, and this small one was around 300,000 won. Instead of buying that, I bought this product that can also wash my first child's dishes, and I think it was a hundred, thousand times better. The most important thing is that it can be used to wash bottles when the baby is newborn! The dishes are really well washed in the dishwasher, but I wondered if the bottles would be washed. My child has stopped taking formula milk, so I put rice paste in it and rubbed it. The sticky stuff stayed on the walls! After the basic standard wash, the foreign substances were cleaned well without stickiness! I think powdered milk or milk oil will also be cleaned well. 1-2 nipple screws can be cleaned well even if placed on a wall stand, but since various baby products such as nipples are light and can fly around, it is better to buy a small cleaning net(?)! I bought this and am using it well ~ I uploaded Before / After from the left, so take a look ~ Oh, and some people said they received samples of detergent when installing, but I didn't. Anyway, I ordered detergent that can be used to wash bottles in advance because I was going to wash it with my baby. When I asked, they said it is different for each store. It is not made by Samsung itself, but is sponsored by some stores to sell their products, so it is different for each store. That is a little. regrettable. Anyway, it is easy to operate and the noise is quieter than expected, so I can put the baby to sleep and turn it on! I wake up to the sound of the microwave running, but the dishwasher doesn't and I sleep well (it makes less noise~). On the contrary, the sound of the water lapping is really nice. It sounds like the sound of a washing machine, but the noise is quieter than that of a washing machine. Seriously, why did I only buy this now? If you've made up your mind, use it as soon as possible. Your quality of life will change. ------------------ As of 5 weeks ago-------------------- I'm still using it very, very well. If the amount is small or it's not too dirty, I spin it quickly, and the last picture is really good at spinning. There was one time when I spun it once but it didn't wash. You have to be careful that small objects like chopsticks don't fall underneath! One of the chopsticks fell out, so the fan that rotates the water stream underneath didn't spin, so it didn't clean. I put the chopstick back in and spun it, and it cleaned well. Most of the time, it cleans well, but when the rice paste gets old and hard, I spin it quickly again ~ I'm going to write it again based on what my friends are curious about. Now that I'm used to it, I stack it on top of the dishes, and my friend asked me if it was okay to stack it like this. For example, if you stack rice bowls diagonally, the water stream goes in between, so it cleans even if you stack several of them. However, if you stack the rice bowls straight in a row, the space where the water stream doesn't go in won't be cleaned, and only the visible part will be cleaned. Is that easy to understand? Don't stack them completely straight, but think of them as slightly spaced out, so that the water stream goes in between and cleans well. Also, I wondered if I really needed to use dishwasher rinse, but I definitely bought it! This is the difference in effect between spraying a coating spray on the windshield of a car and not spraying it. If you don't spray a coating spray, water droplets will form, right? There are water droplets forming and pooling in the rice bowl as well. The rinse coats the dishes, so if you spray a coating spray on your car, it won't form and it will drip down cleanly. Just like that, there is less water left in the rice bowl and it dries quickly. It also has less water stains ~~ I'm so happy to run the dishwasher and clean the sink. If it was helpful, please click the like button and leave. * When a notification pops up, I'll come back to edit my review and tell you the pros and cons because I'm glad it was helpful to someone!

Comments (English): Jin-ja-! I love it! After the basic standard wash, the foreign substances were cleaned well without stickiness! I think powdered milk or milk oil will also be cleaned well. 1-2 nipple screws can be cleaned well even if placed on a wall stand, but since various baby products such as nipples are light and can fly around, it is better to buy a small cleaning net(?)! It is not made by Samsung itself, but is sponsored by some stores to sell their products, so it is different for each store. That is a little. regrettable. Anyway, it is easy to operate and the noise is quieter than expected, so I can put the baby to sleep and turn it on! I wake up to the sound of the microwave running, but the dishwasher doesn't and I sleep well (it makes less noise~). On the contrary, the sound of the water lapping is really nice. I put the chopstick back in and spun it, and it cleaned well. Most of the time, it cleans well, but when the rice paste gets old and hard, I spin it quickly again ~ I'm going to write it again based on what my friends are curious about. For example, if you stack rice bowls diagonally, the water stream goes in between, so it cleans even if you stack several of them. However, if you stack the rice bowls straight in a row, the space where the water stream doesn't go in won't be cleaned, and only the visible part will be cleaned. Is that easy to understand? Don't stack them completely straight, but think of them as slightly spaced out, so that the water stream goes in between and cleans well. This is the difference in effect between spraying a coating spray on the windshield of a car and not spraying it. If you don't spray a coating spray, water droplets will form, right? There are water droplets forming and pooling in the rice bowl as well. The rinse coats the dishes, so if you spray a coating spray on your car, it won't form and it will drip down cleanly. Just like that, there is less water left in the rice bowl and it dries quickly. It also has less water stains ~~ I'm so happy to run the dishwasher and clean the sink. My first child is now eating baby food and washes dishes all day. If I turn my back even a little while washing dishes, he starts crying right away. I had to wash dishes in a hurry or carry the baby while washing dishes, but since I didn't have this, I can play with the baby more and I love this. I don't have a second child yet, but I was thinking of buying a bottle washer even if I had a second child, and this small one was around 300,000 won. Instead of buying that, I bought this product that can also wash my first child's dishes, and I think it was a hundred, thousand times better. The most important thing is that it can be used to wash bottles when the baby is newborn! The dishes are really well washed in the dishwasher, but I wondered if the bottles would be washed. My child has stopped taking formula milk, so I put rice paste in it and rubbed it. The sticky stuff stayed on the walls! After the basic standard wash, the foreign substances were cleaned well without stickiness! I think powdered milk or milk oil will also be cleaned well. 1-2 nipple screws can be cleaned well even if placed on a wall stand, but since various baby products such as nipples are light and can fly around, it is better to buy a small cleaning net(?)! I bought this and am using it well ~ I uploaded Before / After from the left, so take a look ~ Oh, and some people said they received samples of detergent when installing, but I didn't. Anyway, I ordered detergent that can be used to wash bottles in advance because I was going to wash it with my baby. When I asked, they said it is different for each store. It is not made by Samsung itself, but is sponsored by some stores to sell their products, so it is different for each store. That is a little. regrettable. Anyway, it is easy to operate and the noise is quieter than expected, so I can put the baby to sleep and turn it on! I wake up to the sound of the microwave running, but the dishwasher doesn't and I sleep well (it makes less noise~). On the contrary, the sound of the water lapping is really nice. It sounds like the sound of a washing machine, but the noise is quieter than that of a washing machine. Seriously, why did I only buy this now? If you've made up your mind, use it as soon as possible. Your quality of life will change. ------------------ As of 5 weeks ago-------------------- I'm still using it very, very well. If the amount is small or it's not too dirty, I spin it quickly, and the last picture is really good at spinning. There was one time when I spun it once but it didn't wash. You have to be careful that small objects like chopsticks don't fall underneath! One of the chopsticks fell out, so the fan that rotates the water stream underneath didn't spin, so it didn't clean. I put the chopstick back in and spun it, and it cleaned well. Most of the time, it cleans well, but when the rice paste gets old and hard, I spin it quickly again ~ I'm going to write it again based on what my friends are curious about. Now that I'm used to it, I stack it on top of the dishes, and my friend asked me if it was okay to stack it like this. For example, if you stack rice bowls diagonally, the water stream goes in between, so it cleans even if you stack several of them. However, if you stack the rice bowls straight in a row, the space where the water stream doesn't go in won't be cleaned, and only the visible part will be cleaned. Is that easy to understand? Don't stack them completely straight, but think of them as slightly spaced out, so that the water stream goes in between and cleans well. Also, I wondered if I really needed to use dishwasher rinse, but I definitely bought it! This is the difference in effect between spraying a coating spray on the windshield of a car and not spraying it. If you don't spray a coating spray, water droplets will form, right? There are water droplets forming and pooling in the rice bowl as well. The rinse coats the dishes, so if you spray a coating spray on your car, it won't form and it will drip down cleanly. Just like that, there is less water left in the rice bowl and it dries quickly. It also has less water stains ~~ I'm so happy to run the dishwasher and clean the sink. Sentence (English): Now that I'm used to it, I stack it on top of the dishes, and my friend asked me if it was okay to stack it like this.
Comments (English): Jin-ja-! I love it! First of all, the reason for purchasing it was that when my husband and I lived together, I thought a dishwasher was a luxury, but those who have raised babies know that it would be nice to have someone who only washes bottles, right? My first child is now eating baby food and washes dishes all day. If I turn my back even a little while washing dishes, he starts crying right away. I had to wash dishes in a hurry or carry the baby while washing dishes, but since I didn't have this, I can play with the baby more and I love this. I don't have a second child yet, but I was thinking of buying a bottle washer even if I had a second child, and this small one was around 300,000 won. Instead of buying that, I bought this product that can also wash my first child's dishes, and I think it was a hundred, thousand times better. The most important thing is that it can be used to wash bottles when the baby is newborn! The dishes are really well washed in the dishwasher, but I wondered if the bottles would be washed. My child has stopped taking formula milk, so I put rice paste in it and rubbed it. The sticky stuff stayed on the walls! After the basic standard wash, the foreign substances were cleaned well without stickiness! I think powdered milk or milk oil will also be cleaned well. 1-2 nipple screws can be cleaned well even if placed on a wall stand, but since various baby products such as nipples are light and can fly around, it is better to buy a small cleaning net(?)! I bought this and am using it well ~ I uploaded Before / After from the left, so take a look ~ Oh, and some people said they received samples of detergent when installing, but I didn't. Anyway, I ordered detergent that can be used to wash bottles in advance because I was going to wash it with my baby. When I asked, they said it is different for each store. It is not made by Samsung itself, but is sponsored by some stores to sell their products, so it is different for each store. That is a little. regrettable. Anyway, it is easy to operate and the noise is quieter than expected, so I can put the baby to sleep and turn it on! I wake up to the sound of the microwave running, but the dishwasher doesn't and I sleep well (it makes less noise~). On the contrary, the sound of the water lapping is really nice. It sounds like the sound of a washing machine, but the noise is quieter than that of a washing machine. Seriously, why did I only buy this now? If you've made up your mind, use it as soon as possible. Your quality of life will change. ------------------ As of 5 weeks ago-------------------- I'm still using it very, very well. If the amount is small or it's not too dirty, I spin it quickly, and the last picture is really good at spinning. There was one time when I spun it once but it didn't wash. You have to be careful that small objects like chopsticks don't fall underneath! One of the chopsticks fell out, so the fan that rotates the water stream underneath didn't spin, so it didn't clean. I put the chopstick back in and spun it, and it cleaned well. Most of the time, it cleans well, but when the rice paste gets old and hard, I spin it quickly again ~ I'm going to write it again based on what my friends are curious about. Now that I'm used to it, I stack it on top of the dishes, and my friend asked me if it was okay to stack it like this. For example, if you stack rice bowls diagonally, the water stream goes in between, so it cleans even if you stack several of them. However, if you stack the rice bowls straight in a row, the space where the water stream doesn't go in won't be cleaned, and only the visible part will be cleaned. Is that easy to understand? Don't stack them completely straight, but think of them as slightly spaced out, so that the water stream goes in between and cleans well. Also, I wondered if I really needed to use dishwasher rinse, but I definitely bought it! This is the difference in effect between spraying a coating spray on the windshield of a car and not spraying it. If you don't spray a coating spray, water droplets will form, right? There are water droplets forming and pooling in the rice bowl as well. The rinse coats the dishes, so if you spray a coating spray on your car, it won't form and it will drip down cleanly. Just like that, there is less water left in the rice bowl and it dries quickly. It also has less water stains ~~ I'm so happy to run the dishwasher and clean the sink. Of course, they say the bigger the better. However, if you don't have the conditions for a 12-person one, a 6-person one is a must-have. I'm using it without any regrets. I was happier than the day I received a gift from my husband. Let's all escape from dishwashing hell~!

Comments (English): [ Dishwashers are now a must-have ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase - First of all, I have been arguing with my husband over dishwashing for quite some time. Since both of us work, we would often put off doing the dishes when we got home from work. So I wanted to buy a dishwasher for a long time, but everyone around me said that it would be better to buy a 12-person dishwasher instead of a 6-person dishwasher, so I held back. Then, when I had my second child, I stopped working, but I had a lot of things to worry about here and there, so I bought it thinking, 'When will I buy a house and move in?' The result is really, really, really, really, really satisfying. Actual review - It was bigger than I had imagined. I think I should check the kitchen size before moving when I move to my next house. I thought it would be hard to put a dishwasher in a kitchen that was even a little smaller. There is the front and back size, but if you consider the space where you have to open the dishwasher door and put the dishes in, it takes up a lot of space. - I really like the simple design. I liked the clean white color that doesn't spoil the interior of my house. Installation - You need to drill a hole the size of the hole you drill when installing a water purifier. The drilling time was about 3-5 minutes. - Two technicians came to install it. When they came, they told me where to put it so that I didn't have to worry too much about choosing a location. Also, after the installation, they kindly explained the usage method and precautions in detail, which was really nice. (They even recommended dishwasher detergent.) - The pipes have to come out to the sink to drain the water used to wash the dishes. It's a bit in the way or it's a bit noticeable, so it's something that I can definitely handle if I want to use a dishwasher. User review - I think I understand why everyone says that dishwashers are essential home appliances. I've been using it for about two months now and I'm really, really satisfied with it. - I don't have to worry about who will do the dishes with my husband. - Since I don't have time to do the dishes, my dinner time is much more relaxed! Normally, I would have to prepare a meal, eat, wash the dishes, and wash the kids before going to bed, but now I have more time to watch TV with my kids. But as you can see, that little bit of TV time really pays off - the dishes get washed much cleaner than I thought! They actually come out squeakier than when I wash them by hand. I think it's because I wash them at high temperatures. - I think it's perfect for a 4-person household. I can even fit a 4-person pot in there. At first, it was hard to put the dishes in, so I didn't use the space well, but after using it a few times, you'll be able to put in more dishes. (At first, there were a few dishes that didn't wash well because I put them in wrong.) - The downside is that I don't even have to do the dishes by hand anymore. Now, I'm really tired of doing the dishes. Now, I'll just wash my second baby bottle. ***One-liner*** - If you're worried about the practicality of a 6-person dishwasher, just buy it. Of course, they say the bigger the better. However, if you don't have the conditions for a 12-person one, a 6-person one is a must-have. I'm using it without any regrets. I was happier than the day I received a gift from my husband. Let's all escape from dishwashing hell~!

Comments (English): [ Dishwashers are now a must-have ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase - First of all, I have been arguing with my husband over dishwashing for quite some time. Since both of us work, we would often put off doing the dishes when we got home from work. So I wanted to buy a dishwasher for a long time, but everyone around me said that it would be better to buy a 12-person dishwasher instead of a 6-person dishwasher, so I held back. Then, when I had my second child, I stopped working, but I had a lot of things to worry about here and there, so I bought it thinking, 'When will I buy a house and move in?' The result is really, really, really, really, really satisfying. Actual review - It was bigger than I had imagined. I think I should check the kitchen size before moving when I move to my next house. I thought it would be hard to put a dishwasher in a kitchen that was even a little smaller. There is the front and back size, but if you consider the space where you have to open the dishwasher door and put the dishes in, it takes up a lot of space. - I really like the simple design. I liked the clean white color that doesn't spoil the interior of my house. Installation - You need to drill a hole the size of the hole you drill when installing a water purifier. The drilling time was about 3-5 minutes. - Two technicians came to install it. When they came, they told me where to put it so that I didn't have to worry too much about choosing a location. Also, after the installation, they kindly explained the usage method and precautions in detail, which was really nice. (They even recommended dishwasher detergent.) - The pipes have to come out to the sink to drain the water used to wash the dishes. It's a bit in the way or it's a bit noticeable, so it's something that I can definitely handle if I want to use a dishwasher. User review - I think I understand why everyone says that dishwashers are essential home appliances. I've been using it for about two months now and I'm really, really satisfied with it. - I don't have to worry about who will do the dishes with my husband. - Since I don't have time to do the dishes, my dinner time is much more relaxed! Normally, I would have to prepare a meal, eat, wash the dishes, and wash the kids before going to bed, but now I have more time to watch TV with my kids. But as you can see, that little bit of TV time really pays off - the dishes get washed much cleaner than I thought! They actually come out squeakier than when I wash them by hand. I think it's because I wash them at high temperatures. - I think it's perfect for a 4-person household. I can even fit a 4-person pot in there. At first, it was hard to put the dishes in, so I didn't use the space well, but after using it a few times, you'll be able to put in more dishes. (At first, there were a few dishes that didn't wash well because I put them in wrong.) - The downside is that I don't even have to do the dishes by hand anymore. Now, I'm really tired of doing the dishes. Now, I'll just wash my second baby bottle. ***One-liner*** - If you're worried about the practicality of a 6-person dishwasher, just buy it. Of course, they say the bigger the better. However, if you don't have the conditions for a 12-person one, a 6-person one is a must-have. I'm using it without any regrets. I was happier than the day I received a gift from my husband. Let's all escape from dishwashing hell~!

Comments (English): [ Dishwashers are now a must-have ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase - First of all, I have been arguing with my husband over dishwashing for quite some time. Since both of us work, we would often put off doing the dishes when we got home from work. So I wanted to buy a dishwasher for a long time, but everyone around me said that it would be better to buy a 12-person dishwasher instead of a 6-person dishwasher, so I held back. Then, when I had my second child, I stopped working, but I had a lot of things to worry about here and there, so I bought it thinking, 'When will I buy a house and move in?' The result is really, really, really, really, really satisfying. Actual review - It was bigger than I had imagined. I think I should check the kitchen size before moving when I move to my next house. I thought it would be hard to put a dishwasher in a kitchen that was even a little smaller. There is the front and back size, but if you consider the space where you have to open the dishwasher door and put the dishes in, it takes up a lot of space. - I really like the simple design. I liked the clean white color that doesn't spoil the interior of my house. Installation - You need to drill a hole the size of the hole you drill when installing a water purifier. The drilling time was about 3-5 minutes. - Two technicians came to install it. When they came, they told me where to put it so that I didn't have to worry too much about choosing a location. Also, after the installation, they kindly explained the usage method and precautions in detail, which was really nice. (They even recommended dishwasher detergent.) - The pipes have to come out to the sink to drain the water used to wash the dishes. It's a bit in the way or it's a bit noticeable, so it's something that I can definitely handle if I want to use a dishwasher. User review - I think I understand why everyone says that dishwashers are essential home appliances. I've been using it for about two months now and I'm really, really satisfied with it. - I don't have to worry about who will do the dishes with my husband. - Since I don't have time to do the dishes, my dinner time is much more relaxed! Normally, I would have to prepare a meal, eat, wash the dishes, and wash the kids before going to bed, but now I have more time to watch TV with my kids. But as you can see, that little bit of TV time really pays off - the dishes get washed much cleaner than I thought! They actually come out squeakier than when I wash them by hand. I think it's because I wash them at high temperatures. - I think it's perfect for a 4-person household. I can even fit a 4-person pot in there. At first, it was hard to put the dishes in, so I didn't use the space well, but after using it a few times, you'll be able to put in more dishes. (At first, there were a few dishes that didn't wash well because I put them in wrong.) - The downside is that I don't even have to do the dishes by hand anymore. Now, I'm really tired of doing the dishes. Now, I'll just wash my second baby bottle. ***One-liner*** - If you're worried about the practicality of a 6-person dishwasher, just buy it. Of course, they say the bigger the better. However, if you don't have the conditions for a 12-person one, a 6-person one is a must-have. I'm using it without any regrets. I was happier than the day I received a gift from my husband. Let's all escape from dishwashing hell~!

Comments (English): [ Dishwashers are now a must-have ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase - First of all, I have been arguing with my husband over dishwashing for quite some time. Since both of us work, we would often put off doing the dishes when we got home from work. So I wanted to buy a dishwasher for a long time, but everyone around me said that it would be better to buy a 12-person dishwasher instead of a 6-person dishwasher, so I held back. Then, when I had my second child, I stopped working, but I had a lot of things to worry about here and there, so I bought it thinking, 'When will I buy a house and move in?' The result is really, really, really, really, really satisfying. Actual review - It was bigger than I had imagined. I think I should check the kitchen size before moving when I move to my next house. I thought it would be hard to put a dishwasher in a kitchen that was even a little smaller. There is the front and back size, but if you consider the space where you have to open the dishwasher door and put the dishes in, it takes up a lot of space. - I really like the simple design. I liked the clean white color that doesn't spoil the interior of my house. Installation - You need to drill a hole the size of the hole you drill when installing a water purifier. The drilling time was about 3-5 minutes. - Two technicians came to install it. When they came, they told me where to put it so that I didn't have to worry too much about choosing a location. Also, after the installation, they kindly explained the usage method and precautions in detail, which was really nice. (They even recommended dishwasher detergent.) - The pipes have to come out to the sink to drain the water used to wash the dishes. It's a bit in the way or it's a bit noticeable, so it's something that I can definitely handle if I want to use a dishwasher. User review - I think I understand why everyone says that dishwashers are essential home appliances. I've been using it for about two months now and I'm really, really satisfied with it. - I don't have to worry about who will do the dishes with my husband. - Since I don't have time to do the dishes, my dinner time is much more relaxed! Normally, I would have to prepare a meal, eat, wash the dishes, and wash the kids before going to bed, but now I have more time to watch TV with my kids. But as you can see, that little bit of TV time really pays off - the dishes get washed much cleaner than I thought! They actually come out squeakier than when I wash them by hand. I think it's because I wash them at high temperatures. - I think it's perfect for a 4-person household. I can even fit a 4-person pot in there. At first, it was hard to put the dishes in, so I didn't use the space well, but after using it a few times, you'll be able to put in more dishes. (At first, there were a few dishes that didn't wash well because I put them in wrong.) - The downside is that I don't even have to do the dishes by hand anymore. Now, I'm really tired of doing the dishes. Now, I'll just wash my second baby bottle. ***One-liner*** - If you're worried about the practicality of a 6-person dishwasher, just buy it. Of course, they say the bigger the better. However, if you don't have the conditions for a 12-person one, a 6-person one is a must-have. I'm using it without any regrets. I was happier than the day I received a gift from my husband. Let's all escape from dishwashing hell~!

Comments (English): [ Dishwashers are now a must-have ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase - First of all, I have been arguing with my husband over dishwashing for quite some time. The result is really, really, really, really, really satisfying. Actual review - It was bigger than I had imagined. I think I should check the kitchen size before moving when I move to my next house. I thought it would be hard to put a dishwasher in a kitchen that was even a little smaller. There is the front and back size, but if you consider the space where you have to open the dishwasher door and put the dishes in, it takes up a lot of space. - I really like the simple design. The drilling time was about 3-5 minutes. - Two technicians came to install it. When they came, they told me where to put it so that I didn't have to worry too much about choosing a location. Also, after the installation, they kindly explained the usage method and precautions in detail, which was really nice. (They even recommended dishwasher detergent.) - The pipes have to come out to the sink to drain the water used to wash the dishes. It's a bit in the way or it's a bit noticeable, so it's something that I can definitely handle if I want to use a dishwasher. User review - I think I understand why everyone says that dishwashers are essential home appliances. I've been using it for about two months now and I'm really, really satisfied with it. - I don't have to worry about who will do the dishes with my husband. - Since I don't have time to do the dishes, my dinner time is much more relaxed! Normally, I would have to prepare a meal, eat, wash the dishes, and wash the kids before going to bed, but now I have more time to watch TV with my kids. But as you can see, that little bit of TV time really pays off - the dishes get washed much cleaner than I thought! They actually come out squeakier than when I wash them by hand. I think it's because I wash them at high temperatures. - I think it's perfect for a 4-person household. I can even fit a 4-person pot in there. At first, it was hard to put the dishes in, so I didn't use the space well, but after using it a few times, you'll be able to put in more dishes. (At first, there were a few dishes that didn't wash well because I put them in wrong.) - The downside is that I don't even have to do the dishes by hand anymore. Now, I'm really tired of doing the dishes. Now, I'll just wash my second baby bottle. ***One-liner*** - If you're worried about the practicality of a 6-person dishwasher, just buy it. Of course, they say the bigger the better. However, if you don't have the conditions for a 12-person one, a 6-person one is a must-have. I'm using it without any regrets. I was happier than the day I received a gift from my husband. Let's all escape from dishwashing hell~!

Comments (English): [ Dishwashers are now a must-have ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase - First of all, I have been arguing with my husband over dishwashing for quite some time. Since both of us work, we would often put off doing the dishes when we got home from work. So I wanted to buy a dishwasher for a long time, but everyone around me said that it would be better to buy a 12-person dishwasher instead of a 6-person dishwasher, so I held back. Then, when I had my second child, I stopped working, but I had a lot of things to worry about here and there, so I bought it thinking, 'When will I buy a house and move in?' The result is really, really, really, really, really satisfying. Actual review - It was bigger than I had imagined. I think I should check the kitchen size before moving when I move to my next house. I thought it would be hard to put a dishwasher in a kitchen that was even a little smaller. There is the front and back size, but if you consider the space where you have to open the dishwasher door and put the dishes in, it takes up a lot of space. - I really like the simple design. I liked the clean white color that doesn't spoil the interior of my house. Installation - You need to drill a hole the size of the hole you drill when installing a water purifier. The drilling time was about 3-5 minutes. - Two technicians came to install it. When they came, they told me where to put it so that I didn't have to worry too much about choosing a location. Also, after the installation, they kindly explained the usage method and precautions in detail, which was really nice. (They even recommended dishwasher detergent.) - The pipes have to come out to the sink to drain the water used to wash the dishes. It's a bit in the way or it's a bit noticeable, so it's something that I can definitely handle if I want to use a dishwasher. User review - I think I understand why everyone says that dishwashers are essential home appliances. I've been using it for about two months now and I'm really, really satisfied with it. - I don't have to worry about who will do the dishes with my husband. - Since I don't have time to do the dishes, my dinner time is much more relaxed! Normally, I would have to prepare a meal, eat, wash the dishes, and wash the kids before going to bed, but now I have more time to watch TV with my kids. But as you can see, that little bit of TV time really pays off - the dishes get washed much cleaner than I thought! They actually come out squeakier than when I wash them by hand. I think it's because I wash them at high temperatures. - I think it's perfect for a 4-person household. I can even fit a 4-person pot in there. At first, it was hard to put the dishes in, so I didn't use the space well, but after using it a few times, you'll be able to put in more dishes. (At first, there were a few dishes that didn't wash well because I put them in wrong.) - The downside is that I don't even have to do the dishes by hand anymore. Now, I'm really tired of doing the dishes. Now, I'll just wash my second baby bottle. ***One-liner*** - If you're worried about the practicality of a 6-person dishwasher, just buy it. Of course, they say the bigger the better. However, if you don't have the conditions for a 12-person one, a 6-person one is a must-have. I'm using it without any regrets. I was happier than the day I received a gift from my husband. Let's all escape from dishwashing hell~!

Comments (English): [ Dishwashers are now a must-have ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase - First of all, I have been arguing with my husband over dishwashing for quite some time. Also, after the installation, they kindly explained the usage method and precautions in detail, which was really nice. (They even recommended dishwasher detergent.) - The pipes have to come out to the sink to drain the water used to wash the dishes. It's a bit in the way or it's a bit noticeable, so it's something that I can definitely handle if I want to use a dishwasher. User review - I think I understand why everyone says that dishwashers are essential home appliances. I've been using it for about two months now and I'm really, really satisfied with it. - I don't have to worry about who will do the dishes with my husband. - Since I don't have time to do the dishes, my dinner time is much more relaxed! Normally, I would have to prepare a meal, eat, wash the dishes, and wash the kids before going to bed, but now I have more time to watch TV with my kids. I think it's because I wash them at high temperatures. - I think it's perfect for a 4-person household. I can even fit a 4-person pot in there. (At first, there were a few dishes that didn't wash well because I put them in wrong.) - The downside is that I don't even have to do the dishes by hand anymore. Now, I'm really tired of doing the dishes. Now, I'll just wash my second baby bottle. ***One-liner*** - If you're worried about the practicality of a 6-person dishwasher, just buy it. I was happier than the day I received a gift from my husband. Let's all escape from dishwashing hell~!

Sentence (English): Since I don't have time to do the dishes, my dinner time is much more relaxed!
Comments (English): [ Dishwashers are now a must-have ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase - First of all, I have been arguing with my husband over dishwashing for quite some time. Since both of us work, we would often put off doing the dishes when we got home from work. So I wanted to buy a dishwasher for a long time, but everyone around me said that it would be better to buy a 12-person dishwasher instead of a 6-person dishwasher, so I held back. Then, when I had my second child, I stopped working, but I had a lot of things to worry about here and there, so I bought it thinking, 'When will I buy a house and move in?' The result is really, really, really, really, really satisfying. Actual review - It was bigger than I had imagined. I think I should check the kitchen size before moving when I move to my next house. I thought it would be hard to put a dishwasher in a kitchen that was even a little smaller. There is the front and back size, but if you consider the space where you have to open the dishwasher door and put the dishes in, it takes up a lot of space. - I really like the simple design. I liked the clean white color that doesn't spoil the interior of my house. Installation - You need to drill a hole the size of the hole you drill when installing a water purifier. The drilling time was about 3-5 minutes. - Two technicians came to install it. When they came, they told me where to put it so that I didn't have to worry too much about choosing a location. Also, after the installation, they kindly explained the usage method and precautions in detail, which was really nice. (They even recommended dishwasher detergent.) - The pipes have to come out to the sink to drain the water used to wash the dishes. It's a bit in the way or it's a bit noticeable, so it's something that I can definitely handle if I want to use a dishwasher. User review - I think I understand why everyone says that dishwashers are essential home appliances. I've been using it for about two months now and I'm really, really satisfied with it. - I don't have to worry about who will do the dishes with my husband. - Since I don't have time to do the dishes, my dinner time is much more relaxed! Normally, I would have to prepare a meal, eat, wash the dishes, and wash the kids before going to bed, but now I have more time to watch TV with my kids. But as you can see, that little bit of TV time really pays off - the dishes get washed much cleaner than I thought! They actually come out squeakier than when I wash them by hand. I think it's because I wash them at high temperatures. - I think it's perfect for a 4-person household. I can even fit a 4-person pot in there. At first, it was hard to put the dishes in, so I didn't use the space well, but after using it a few times, you'll be able to put in more dishes. (At first, there were a few dishes that didn't wash well because I put them in wrong.) - The downside is that I don't even have to do the dishes by hand anymore. Now, I'm really tired of doing the dishes. Now, I'll just wash my second baby bottle. ***One-liner*** - If you're worried about the practicality of a 6-person dishwasher, just buy it. Of course, they say the bigger the better. However, if you don't have the conditions for a 12-person one, a 6-person one is a must-have. I'm using it without any regrets. I was happier than the day I received a gift from my husband. Let's all escape from dishwashing hell~!

Sentence (English): But as you can see, that little bit of TV time really pays off - the dishes get washed much cleaner than I thought!
Comments (English): [ Dishwashers are now a must-have ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase - First of all, I have been arguing with my husband over dishwashing for quite some time. Since both of us work, we would often put off doing the dishes when we got home from work. So I wanted to buy a dishwasher for a long time, but everyone around me said that it would be better to buy a 12-person dishwasher instead of a 6-person dishwasher, so I held back. Then, when I had my second child, I stopped working, but I had a lot of things to worry about here and there, so I bought it thinking, 'When will I buy a house and move in?' The result is really, really, really, really, really satisfying. Actual review - It was bigger than I had imagined. I think I should check the kitchen size before moving when I move to my next house. I thought it would be hard to put a dishwasher in a kitchen that was even a little smaller. There is the front and back size, but if you consider the space where you have to open the dishwasher door and put the dishes in, it takes up a lot of space. - I really like the simple design. I liked the clean white color that doesn't spoil the interior of my house. Installation - You need to drill a hole the size of the hole you drill when installing a water purifier. The drilling time was about 3-5 minutes. - Two technicians came to install it. When they came, they told me where to put it so that I didn't have to worry too much about choosing a location. Also, after the installation, they kindly explained the usage method and precautions in detail, which was really nice. (They even recommended dishwasher detergent.) - The pipes have to come out to the sink to drain the water used to wash the dishes. It's a bit in the way or it's a bit noticeable, so it's something that I can definitely handle if I want to use a dishwasher. User review - I think I understand why everyone says that dishwashers are essential home appliances. I've been using it for about two months now and I'm really, really satisfied with it. - I don't have to worry about who will do the dishes with my husband. - Since I don't have time to do the dishes, my dinner time is much more relaxed! Normally, I would have to prepare a meal, eat, wash the dishes, and wash the kids before going to bed, but now I have more time to watch TV with my kids. But as you can see, that little bit of TV time really pays off - the dishes get washed much cleaner than I thought! They actually come out squeakier than when I wash them by hand. I think it's because I wash them at high temperatures. - I think it's perfect for a 4-person household. I can even fit a 4-person pot in there. At first, it was hard to put the dishes in, so I didn't use the space well, but after using it a few times, you'll be able to put in more dishes. (At first, there were a few dishes that didn't wash well because I put them in wrong.) - The downside is that I don't even have to do the dishes by hand anymore. Now, I'm really tired of doing the dishes. Now, I'll just wash my second baby bottle. ***One-liner*** - If you're worried about the practicality of a 6-person dishwasher, just buy it. Of course, they say the bigger the better. However, if you don't have the conditions for a 12-person one, a 6-person one is a must-have. I'm using it without any regrets. I was happier than the day I received a gift from my husband. Let's all escape from dishwashing hell~!

Comments (English): [ Dishwashers are now a must-have ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase - First of all, I have been arguing with my husband over dishwashing for quite some time. Since both of us work, we would often put off doing the dishes when we got home from work. So I wanted to buy a dishwasher for a long time, but everyone around me said that it would be better to buy a 12-person dishwasher instead of a 6-person dishwasher, so I held back. Then, when I had my second child, I stopped working, but I had a lot of things to worry about here and there, so I bought it thinking, 'When will I buy a house and move in?' The result is really, really, really, really, really satisfying. Actual review - It was bigger than I had imagined. I think I should check the kitchen size before moving when I move to my next house. I thought it would be hard to put a dishwasher in a kitchen that was even a little smaller. There is the front and back size, but if you consider the space where you have to open the dishwasher door and put the dishes in, it takes up a lot of space. - I really like the simple design. I liked the clean white color that doesn't spoil the interior of my house. Installation - You need to drill a hole the size of the hole you drill when installing a water purifier. The drilling time was about 3-5 minutes. - Two technicians came to install it. When they came, they told me where to put it so that I didn't have to worry too much about choosing a location. Also, after the installation, they kindly explained the usage method and precautions in detail, which was really nice. (They even recommended dishwasher detergent.) - The pipes have to come out to the sink to drain the water used to wash the dishes. It's a bit in the way or it's a bit noticeable, so it's something that I can definitely handle if I want to use a dishwasher. User review - I think I understand why everyone says that dishwashers are essential home appliances. I've been using it for about two months now and I'm really, really satisfied with it. - I don't have to worry about who will do the dishes with my husband. - Since I don't have time to do the dishes, my dinner time is much more relaxed! Normally, I would have to prepare a meal, eat, wash the dishes, and wash the kids before going to bed, but now I have more time to watch TV with my kids. But as you can see, that little bit of TV time really pays off - the dishes get washed much cleaner than I thought! They actually come out squeakier than when I wash them by hand. I think it's because I wash them at high temperatures. - I think it's perfect for a 4-person household. I can even fit a 4-person pot in there. At first, it was hard to put the dishes in, so I didn't use the space well, but after using it a few times, you'll be able to put in more dishes. (At first, there were a few dishes that didn't wash well because I put them in wrong.) - The downside is that I don't even have to do the dishes by hand anymore. Now, I'm really tired of doing the dishes. Now, I'll just wash my second baby bottle. ***One-liner*** - If you're worried about the practicality of a 6-person dishwasher, just buy it. Of course, they say the bigger the better. However, if you don't have the conditions for a 12-person one, a 6-person one is a must-have. I'm using it without any regrets. I was happier than the day I received a gift from my husband. Let's all escape from dishwashing hell~!

Comments (English): [ Dishwashers are now a must-have ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase - First of all, I have been arguing with my husband over dishwashing for quite some time. Since both of us work, we would often put off doing the dishes when we got home from work. So I wanted to buy a dishwasher for a long time, but everyone around me said that it would be better to buy a 12-person dishwasher instead of a 6-person dishwasher, so I held back. Then, when I had my second child, I stopped working, but I had a lot of things to worry about here and there, so I bought it thinking, 'When will I buy a house and move in?' The result is really, really, really, really, really satisfying. Actual review - It was bigger than I had imagined. I think I should check the kitchen size before moving when I move to my next house. I thought it would be hard to put a dishwasher in a kitchen that was even a little smaller. There is the front and back size, but if you consider the space where you have to open the dishwasher door and put the dishes in, it takes up a lot of space. - I really like the simple design. I liked the clean white color that doesn't spoil the interior of my house. Installation - You need to drill a hole the size of the hole you drill when installing a water purifier. The drilling time was about 3-5 minutes. - Two technicians came to install it. When they came, they told me where to put it so that I didn't have to worry too much about choosing a location. Also, after the installation, they kindly explained the usage method and precautions in detail, which was really nice. (They even recommended dishwasher detergent.) - The pipes have to come out to the sink to drain the water used to wash the dishes. It's a bit in the way or it's a bit noticeable, so it's something that I can definitely handle if I want to use a dishwasher. User review - I think I understand why everyone says that dishwashers are essential home appliances. I've been using it for about two months now and I'm really, really satisfied with it. - I don't have to worry about who will do the dishes with my husband. - Since I don't have time to do the dishes, my dinner time is much more relaxed! Normally, I would have to prepare a meal, eat, wash the dishes, and wash the kids before going to bed, but now I have more time to watch TV with my kids. But as you can see, that little bit of TV time really pays off - the dishes get washed much cleaner than I thought! They actually come out squeakier than when I wash them by hand. I think it's because I wash them at high temperatures. - I think it's perfect for a 4-person household. I can even fit a 4-person pot in there. At first, it was hard to put the dishes in, so I didn't use the space well, but after using it a few times, you'll be able to put in more dishes. (At first, there were a few dishes that didn't wash well because I put them in wrong.) - The downside is that I don't even have to do the dishes by hand anymore. Now, I'm really tired of doing the dishes. Now, I'll just wash my second baby bottle. ***One-liner*** - If you're worried about the practicality of a 6-person dishwasher, just buy it. Of course, they say the bigger the better. However, if you don't have the conditions for a 12-person one, a 6-person one is a must-have. I'm using it without any regrets. I was happier than the day I received a gift from my husband. Let's all escape from dishwashing hell~!

Comments (English): [ Dishwashers are now a must-have ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase - First of all, I have been arguing with my husband over dishwashing for quite some time. Since both of us work, we would often put off doing the dishes when we got home from work. So I wanted to buy a dishwasher for a long time, but everyone around me said that it would be better to buy a 12-person dishwasher instead of a 6-person dishwasher, so I held back. Then, when I had my second child, I stopped working, but I had a lot of things to worry about here and there, so I bought it thinking, 'When will I buy a house and move in?' The result is really, really, really, really, really satisfying. Actual review - It was bigger than I had imagined. I think I should check the kitchen size before moving when I move to my next house. I thought it would be hard to put a dishwasher in a kitchen that was even a little smaller. There is the front and back size, but if you consider the space where you have to open the dishwasher door and put the dishes in, it takes up a lot of space. - I really like the simple design. I liked the clean white color that doesn't spoil the interior of my house. Installation - You need to drill a hole the size of the hole you drill when installing a water purifier. The drilling time was about 3-5 minutes. - Two technicians came to install it. When they came, they told me where to put it so that I didn't have to worry too much about choosing a location. Also, after the installation, they kindly explained the usage method and precautions in detail, which was really nice. (They even recommended dishwasher detergent.) - The pipes have to come out to the sink to drain the water used to wash the dishes. It's a bit in the way or it's a bit noticeable, so it's something that I can definitely handle if I want to use a dishwasher. User review - I think I understand why everyone says that dishwashers are essential home appliances. I've been using it for about two months now and I'm really, really satisfied with it. - I don't have to worry about who will do the dishes with my husband. - Since I don't have time to do the dishes, my dinner time is much more relaxed! Normally, I would have to prepare a meal, eat, wash the dishes, and wash the kids before going to bed, but now I have more time to watch TV with my kids. But as you can see, that little bit of TV time really pays off - the dishes get washed much cleaner than I thought! They actually come out squeakier than when I wash them by hand. I think it's because I wash them at high temperatures. - I think it's perfect for a 4-person household. I can even fit a 4-person pot in there. At first, it was hard to put the dishes in, so I didn't use the space well, but after using it a few times, you'll be able to put in more dishes. (At first, there were a few dishes that didn't wash well because I put them in wrong.) - The downside is that I don't even have to do the dishes by hand anymore. Now, I'm really tired of doing the dishes. Now, I'll just wash my second baby bottle. ***One-liner*** - If you're worried about the practicality of a 6-person dishwasher, just buy it. Of course, they say the bigger the better. However, if you don't have the conditions for a 12-person one, a 6-person one is a must-have. I'm using it without any regrets. I was happier than the day I received a gift from my husband. Let's all escape from dishwashing hell~!

Also, after the installation, they kindly explained the usage method and precautions in detail, which was really nice. (They even recommended dishwasher detergent.) - The pipes have to come out to the sink to drain the water used to wash the dishes. It's a bit in the way or it's a bit noticeable, so it's something that I can definitely handle if I want to use a dishwasher. User review - I think I understand why everyone says that dishwashers are essential home appliances. I've been using it for about two months now and I'm really, really satisfied with it. - I don't have to worry about who will do the dishes with my husband. - Since I don't have time to do the dishes, my dinner time is much more relaxed! Normally, I would have to prepare a meal, eat, wash the dishes, and wash the kids before going to bed, but now I have more time to watch TV with my kids. I think it's because I wash them at high temperatures. - I think it's perfect for a 4-person household. I can even fit a 4-person pot in there. At first, it was hard to put the dishes in, so I didn't use the space well, but after using it a few times, you'll be able to put in more dishes. (At first, there were a few dishes that didn't wash well because I put them in wrong.) - The downside is that I don't even have to do the dishes by hand anymore. Now, I'm really tired of doing the dishes. Now, I'll just wash my second baby bottle. ***One-liner*** - If you're worried about the practicality of a 6-person dishwasher, just buy it. I was happier than the day I received a gift from my husband. Let's all escape from dishwashing hell~!

Sentence (English): One-liner*** - If you're worried about the practicality of a 6-person dishwasher, just buy it.
Comments (English): [ Dishwashers are now a must-have ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase - First of all, I have been arguing with my husband over dishwashing for quite some time. Since both of us work, we would often put off doing the dishes when we got home from work. So I wanted to buy a dishwasher for a long time, but everyone around me said that it would be better to buy a 12-person dishwasher instead of a 6-person dishwasher, so I held back. Then, when I had my second child, I stopped working, but I had a lot of things to worry about here and there, so I bought it thinking, 'When will I buy a house and move in?' The result is really, really, really, really, really satisfying. Actual review - It was bigger than I had imagined. I think I should check the kitchen size before moving when I move to my next house. I thought it would be hard to put a dishwasher in a kitchen that was even a little smaller. There is the front and back size, but if you consider the space where you have to open the dishwasher door and put the dishes in, it takes up a lot of space. - I really like the simple design. I liked the clean white color that doesn't spoil the interior of my house. Installation - You need to drill a hole the size of the hole you drill when installing a water purifier. The drilling time was about 3-5 minutes. - Two technicians came to install it. When they came, they told me where to put it so that I didn't have to worry too much about choosing a location. Also, after the installation, they kindly explained the usage method and precautions in detail, which was really nice. (They even recommended dishwasher detergent.) - The pipes have to come out to the sink to drain the water used to wash the dishes. It's a bit in the way or it's a bit noticeable, so it's something that I can definitely handle if I want to use a dishwasher. User review - I think I understand why everyone says that dishwashers are essential home appliances. I've been using it for about two months now and I'm really, really satisfied with it. - I don't have to worry about who will do the dishes with my husband. - Since I don't have time to do the dishes, my dinner time is much more relaxed! Normally, I would have to prepare a meal, eat, wash the dishes, and wash the kids before going to bed, but now I have more time to watch TV with my kids. But as you can see, that little bit of TV time really pays off - the dishes get washed much cleaner than I thought! They actually come out squeakier than when I wash them by hand. I think it's because I wash them at high temperatures. - I think it's perfect for a 4-person household. I can even fit a 4-person pot in there. At first, it was hard to put the dishes in, so I didn't use the space well, but after using it a few times, you'll be able to put in more dishes. (At first, there were a few dishes that didn't wash well because I put them in wrong.) - The downside is that I don't even have to do the dishes by hand anymore. Now, I'm really tired of doing the dishes. Now, I'll just wash my second baby bottle. ***One-liner*** - If you're worried about the practicality of a 6-person dishwasher, just buy it. Of course, they say the bigger the better. However, if you don't have the conditions for a 12-person one, a 6-person one is a must-have. I'm using it without any regrets. I was happier than the day I received a gift from my husband. Let's all escape from dishwashing hell~!

Sentence (English): I was happier than the day I received a gift from my husband.
Comments (English): [ Dishwashers are now a must-have ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase - First of all, I have been arguing with my husband over dishwashing for quite some time. Since both of us work, we would often put off doing the dishes when we got home from work. So I wanted to buy a dishwasher for a long time, but everyone around me said that it would be better to buy a 12-person dishwasher instead of a 6-person dishwasher, so I held back. Then, when I had my second child, I stopped working, but I had a lot of things to worry about here and there, so I bought it thinking, 'When will I buy a house and move in?' The result is really, really, really, really, really satisfying. Actual review - It was bigger than I had imagined. I think I should check the kitchen size before moving when I move to my next house. I thought it would be hard to put a dishwasher in a kitchen that was even a little smaller. There is the front and back size, but if you consider the space where you have to open the dishwasher door and put the dishes in, it takes up a lot of space. - I really like the simple design. I liked the clean white color that doesn't spoil the interior of my house. Installation - You need to drill a hole the size of the hole you drill when installing a water purifier. The drilling time was about 3-5 minutes. - Two technicians came to install it. When they came, they told me where to put it so that I didn't have to worry too much about choosing a location. Also, after the installation, they kindly explained the usage method and precautions in detail, which was really nice. (They even recommended dishwasher detergent.) - The pipes have to come out to the sink to drain the water used to wash the dishes. It's a bit in the way or it's a bit noticeable, so it's something that I can definitely handle if I want to use a dishwasher. User review - I think I understand why everyone says that dishwashers are essential home appliances. I've been using it for about two months now and I'm really, really satisfied with it. - I don't have to worry about who will do the dishes with my husband. - Since I don't have time to do the dishes, my dinner time is much more relaxed! Normally, I would have to prepare a meal, eat, wash the dishes, and wash the kids before going to bed, but now I have more time to watch TV with my kids. But as you can see, that little bit of TV time really pays off - the dishes get washed much cleaner than I thought! They actually come out squeakier than when I wash them by hand. I think it's because I wash them at high temperatures. - I think it's perfect for a 4-person household. I can even fit a 4-person pot in there. At first, it was hard to put the dishes in, so I didn't use the space well, but after using it a few times, you'll be able to put in more dishes. (At first, there were a few dishes that didn't wash well because I put them in wrong.) - The downside is that I don't even have to do the dishes by hand anymore. Now, I'm really tired of doing the dishes. Now, I'll just wash my second baby bottle. ***One-liner*** - If you're worried about the practicality of a 6-person dishwasher, just buy it. Of course, they say the bigger the better. However, if you don't have the conditions for a 12-person one, a 6-person one is a must-have. I'm using it without any regrets. I was happier than the day I received a gift from my husband. Let's all escape from dishwashing hell~!

Sentence (English): I am a housewife who has been using a dishwasher for 10 years.
Comments (English): [ Hello, dishwasher aunts. ] || ---------------- || I am a housewife who has been using a dishwasher for 10 years. First of all, my house used to have a built-in 12-person dishwasher and I used it well for a long time. When I moved in, there was no dishwasher here and the kitchen storage space was not enough because it was built-in, so I spent two weeks without a dishwasher. I kept thinking about Auntie Dishwasher, who can never be left behind once you use it. My husband suggested that I get a dishwasher because I would get stressed out after washing and eating, so I agreed right away. After searching through Coupang, I bought a 2023 model at the lowest price with a 5-year warranty insurance. I bought it the next day because I forgot the insurance and canceled it. The price fluctuated a little, so I was a little disappointed, but the quick installation made me feel better right away. The next day after I bought it, two installers came and installed it in the desired location and demonstrated how to use it directly, and they were very kind. As soon as it was installed on the first day, I put in cups and other things and turned it on. It ran on the standard course for about an hour, and the auto-open function was convenient. It's bigger than I thought, so my small kitchen feels even smaller, but I love that I can keep the dishes on time. The advantage I felt after using it for about 3 days is that it seems to wash well after washing the larvae. It's good because I don't have to bend over compared to built-ins. There's no water on the floor. Those who have used built-ins probably know this. If you turn it twice every morning and evening when the dishes come out, flies won't get caught, so it's hygienic and there's no lack of storage space. The design is neat and simple, and it goes well with the space. Pots and large plates and silicone cutting boards fit well. The disadvantage is that, compared to built-ins, it obviously takes up the counter space above, so it may look cramped and lacking in space. It opens a little bit automatically, but like with built-ins, it dries faster and better if you open the door wide. That way, the dishes dry well. If you have a lot of family members and cook a lot, you might feel that it's a little small. My family is a house of 3 people and there are a lot of cups, but it wasn't too bad. By the way, I enjoy drinking as well, so I put a soju glass in it and it didn't spill and was easy to clean. I think I bought a Samsung product at this price. I bought a small business product before, but there were a lot of complaints about installation delays, so I canceled and bought it here. As expected, the installation is the best. I don't regret it. If my opinion was even a little helpful in your purchase, please click 'Helpful' :)
Comments (Original): [ 식세기 이모 들이세요. ] || ---------------- || 식세기 사용 10년차 주부입니다. 우선 전에 집은 빌트인 12인용 식세기가 있었고  오래도록 잘사용했었죠. 이사오고 여긴 식세기가 없고 빌트인을 하기에 주방쪽 수납이 넉넉지 않은 구조라 2주 동안 식세기 없는 시간을 보냈는데요. 한번써본 사람은 절대 벗어날수없는 식세기 이모님이 자꾸 생각나더라고요. 일일이 거품내고 세척하고 밥먹고 나면 스트레스로 까칠해지는 저를 위해 남편이 식세기를 들이자고 먼저 제안해주어서 바로 승낙ㅋ  폭풍검색으로 쿠팡에서 제가 구입할 당시 23년도 모델을 최저가에 5년 안심보증보험 추가해서 잘 구입했던것 같아요.  중간에 보험 빼먹고 구입해서 취소 후 다음날 재구입 했는데 가격변동이 약간 있어서 조금 그랬지만 빠른 설치에 기분이 바로 풀렸네요. 구입 후 다음날 설치기사님 두분이 오셔서 원하는 위치에 잘설치해주시고 작동법도 직접 시연해 주시면서 친절하게 응대해주셨어요.  첫날 설치되자마자 컵이랑 이것저것 넣고 돌려보니 한시간 정도 표준코스로 돌아갔고 자동 열림기능 있어 편리했습니다. 생각보다 사이즈가 커서 저의 작디작은 주방이 더작아진 기분이지만 설거지에서 제시간을 지킬 수 있어 너무 좋아요.  제가 3일정도 써보고 느낀 장점은 애벌 세척후 넣으면 잘 씻기는것 같고요. 빌트인에 비해 허리를 숙일 필요 없어서 좋아요. 바닥에 물 흥건해질 일도 없고요. 요건 빌트인 써보신 분은 아실듯. 아침 저녁 두번 그릇 나올때마다 돌리면 날파리 꼬일일 없어 위생적이고 적재공간 부족하지 않아요.  디자인도 깔끔하고 군더더기 없이 공간에 잘 어울려요. 냄비도 잘들어가고 큰 식판, 실리콘 도마도 잘들어가네요. 단점은요. 빌트인에 비해서 당연히 위에 조리대공간을 차지해서 공간이 부족하고 좁아 보일수있다는 것이고 자동열림으로 조금 열리는데 빌트인때도 그랬지만 문을 활짝 개방해주시는게 더 빠르게 잘마르고 좋아요.  그래야 그릇 건조가 잘됩니다.  식구 많고 요리 많이 하셔서 그릇 많이 나오는 집은 조금 작다고 느끼실것 같아요. 저희집은 3인이고 컵이 많이 나오는 집인데 부족하지 않았어요. 참고로 반주도 즐기는 편이라 소주잔도 넣어보니 엎어지지 않고 세척 잘되네요. 저는 삼성 대기업 제품 이가격에 잘샀다고 생각합니다. 전에 중소기업제품 구입했다가 설치 지연 말이 많아서 취소하고 여기서 구입했는데 역시 설치 최고입니다. 후회 없네요. 제 의견이 구매에 조금이나마 도움이 되셨다면  '도움돼요' 꾹 부탁드려요:)

Comments (English): [ I'm satisfied with this~ ] || ---------------- || While I was thinking about buying a dishwasher, I saw it on Coupang at night and ordered it in a hurry. When I checked it in detail the next day, it was a 21-year-old product. The 23-year-old product had an upgraded rinse function, so there was a price difference of about 80,000 won, so I called the customer service center and requested to cancel the 21-year-old product purchase and immediately purchased the 23-year-old product. I had it installed last Saturday and ran it on the sterilization course thinking I would wash the inside once. I bought a special detergent from Coupang (the installer gave me a detergent purchase coupon, but I was annoyed because I had to install the app and register as a member), and I received the detergent via rocket delivery on Sunday afternoon. For the first use, I washed the dishes thoroughly while rubbing them in hot water with rubber gloves, and then I put in 1/4 of the detergent and ran it on the standard setting. There was no smell and it washed well without any stains. I was satisfied~^^ On Monday evening, I roughly washed the dishes and added a strong rinse to the previous day, and as expected, there was no smell and it washed well. I'm worried about my credit card bill next month, but I made a good purchase with this~ I'm satisfied. ~~~~~~~~4th review~~~~~~~~ After the 4th wash, the door opens automatically and I take them out one by one to check, and one chopstick fell through the gap and got caught diagonally at the bottom, so the rotating blade at the bottom couldn't rotate. (I guess) The dishes placed on one side didn't get washed properly. The installer said to put the dishes in carefully so that they don't fall down, and I think I need to be especially careful when putting in the chopsticks. ~~~~~~~~After using it for about a month~~~~~~~~~~~ Overall, I'm satisfied and using it well. If I stack them too much, they get stains in some places. One thing is that I'm sensitive (this could be a detergent problem), but the stainless steel cup smells fishy when I drink hot water. According to another person's review, if the water smells fishy, put some vinegar in a small bowl and run the dishwasher. After putting the vinegar in and running the dishwasher again, the stainless steel cup no longer smells fishy. ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ <Family of 4> Except when the kids are on vacation, we usually eat a simple breakfast at home on weekdays or sometimes we don't eat breakfast, and we only eat one proper dinner, so I only have to turn the dishwashing machine over once a day. On the weekends, I have a quick lunch and dinner, so I sometimes turn the dishwashing machine over twice. I wash pots, frying pans, and large mixing bowls by hand.

When I'm at home, I take the dishes out on the drying rack after washing them. Since the dishes are warm, they dry quickly. With just the door opening function, it takes a long time for them to dry completely because they're all clumped together like Tetris in the narrow space of the dishwasher. It's a bit of a hassle, but since there aren't many of them anyway, I move them one more time to prevent the fishy smell. If that's too much trouble, it might be better to open the door wide and take the basket out to dry it. *Maintenance cost: Considering the cost of each detergent tablet (200-300), it's much more expensive than conventional dishwashing detergent, but considering the convenience, it's well worth the investment. *Disappointing thing: If there had been a low-temperature mode (around 50 degrees?), I think I could have cleaned the humidifier disc and used dishes that cannot be used at high temperatures. (That's how satisfied I am!) *Noise: Other than the noise when discharging water and about three vibrations?, I didn't feel it was particularly loud. It didn't happen for the entire 65 minutes, but rather at specific moments, so it was much quieter than I thought. (I might have been more prepared because of the noise mentioned in the review.) *Installation: Even though it's in a very remote area, the installation was very fast, and the installer was friendly and nice. I also purchased insurance, but the best thing is that I won't have to use it, but I'm confident that it will be handled well since Coupang guarantees it. I'm very satisfied with this product, especially when a full-size dishwasher isn't possible or space is limited. I was debating between the Wash* and the Media, but if I had purchased the Wash*, the top installation would have been a bit tricky. When I'm at home, I take the dishes out on the drying rack after washing them. Since the dishes are warm, they dry quickly. With just the door opening function, it takes a long time for them to dry completely because they're all clumped together like Tetris in the narrow space of the dishwasher. It's a bit of a hassle, but since there aren't many of them anyway, I move them one more time to prevent the fishy smell.
