(That's how satisfied I am!) *Noise: Other than the noise when discharging water and about three vibrations?, I didn't feel it was particularly loud. It didn't happen for the entire 65 minutes, but rather at specific moments, so it was much quieter than I thought. (I might have been more prepared because of the noise mentioned in the review.) *Installation: Even though it's in a very remote area, the installation was very fast, and the installer was friendly and nice. I also purchased insurance, but the best thing is that I won't have to use it, but I'm confident that it will be handled well since Coupang guarantees it. I'm very satisfied with this product, especially when a full-size dishwasher isn't possible or space is limited. I was debating between the Wash* and the Media, but if I had purchased the Wash*, the top installation would have been a bit tricky. When I'm at home, I take the dishes out on the drying rack after washing them. Since the dishes are warm, they dry quickly. With just the door opening function, it takes a long time for them to dry completely because they're all clumped together like Tetris in the narrow space of the dishwasher. (That's how satisfied I am!) *Noise: Other than the noise when discharging water and about three vibrations?, I didn't feel it was particularly loud. It didn't happen for the entire 65 minutes, but rather at specific moments, so it was much quieter than I thought. (I might have been more prepared because of the noise mentioned in the review.) *Installation: Even though it's in a very remote area, the installation was very fast, and the installer was friendly and nice. (For breakfast, yogurt and fruit. For dinner, we tend to eat mainly single dishes, so there isn't much to wash.) For a family that eats regular meals, running it after one meal would be enough. When I'm at home, I take the dishes out on the drying rack after washing them. Since the dishes are warm, they dry quickly. With just the door opening function, it takes a long time for them to dry completely because they're all clumped together like Tetris in the narrow space of the dishwasher. It's a bit of a hassle, but since there aren't many of them anyway, I move them one more time to prevent the fishy smell. If that's too much trouble, it might be better to open the door wide and take the basket out to dry it. *Maintenance cost: Considering the cost of each detergent tablet (200-300), it's much more expensive than conventional dishwashing detergent, but considering the convenience, it's well worth the investment. *Disappointing thing: If there had been a low-temperature mode (around 50 degrees?), I think I could have cleaned the humidifier disc and used dishes that cannot be used at high temperatures. (That's how satisfied I am!) *Noise: Other than the noise when discharging water and about three vibrations?, I didn't feel it was particularly loud. It didn't happen for the entire 65 minutes, but rather at specific moments, so it was much quieter than I thought. (I might have been more prepared because of the noise mentioned in the review.) *Installation: Even though it's in a very remote area, the installation was very fast, and the installer was friendly and nice. I also purchased insurance, but the best thing is that I won't have to use it, but I'm confident that it will be handled well since Coupang guarantees it. I'm very satisfied with this product, especially when a full-size dishwasher isn't possible or space is limited. I was debating between the Wash* and the Media, but if I had purchased the Wash*, the top installation would have been a bit tricky. There's a difference of about 15cm, which is a much bigger difference than I thought. I really wanted the door to open towards the sink, but if I had purchased a larger one, I would have had to remove the dish drying rack, and it would have interfered with the faucet, which would have been very inconvenient. The fact that the interior is made of stainless steel on all four sides and that the water streams from three directions also played a role in my decision. Sentence (English): *Usage Period: 1 week. *
Comments (English): [ The easiest to use ] || ---------------- || *Usage Period: 1 week. *Family Composition: 2 people. *Usage Pattern: It feels wasteful to run it for just one meal, but if I combine two meals, it is just the right amount after subtracting the dishes to be washed by hand. (Breakfast is usually just yogurt and fruit. Dinner tends to be a gourmet meal, so there aren't many dishes to wash.) For households with typical meals, running it after one meal should suffice. When I am at home, I take the dishes out onto the drying rack after the wash is finished. Since the dishes are still warm, they dry quickly. Using only the door opening function takes a long time for them to dry completely because they are packed tightly together like Tetris in the narrow space of the dishwasher. It is a bit of a hassle, but since there aren't that many dishes anyway, I move them around one more time to prevent a musty smell. If that is too much trouble, it would be better to at least open the door wide and take the basket out to dry them. *Maintenance Cost: Considering the cost per detergent tablet (200-300), it is on the expensive side compared to conventional hand-washing detergent, but considering the convenience, it is a worthwhile investment. * Areas for Improvement: I wish there had been a low-temperature mode (around 50 degrees?) so I could have cleaned the humidifier discs or washed dishes that cannot be used at high temperatures. (That’s how satisfied I am!) *Noise: Aside from the noise when draining water and about three vibrations, I didn't find it particularly loud. Since the noise occurs at specific moments rather than throughout the entire 65-minute run, I found it much quieter than I expected. (Maybe I felt that way because I was prepared for the noise due to the reviews mentioning it.) *Installation: Even though I live in a very remote area, the installation was very fast, and the technician was kind and helpful. I also purchased insurance; while it would be best if I never had to use it, I trust that the issue will be handled well since it is guaranteed by Coupang. I believe this is the best product available for those who cannot install a large dishwasher or have limited space on the countertop. I debated between this and Wash* before purchasing the Midea; if I had bought the Wash*, installing it on the countertop would have been a bit tricky. There was a difference of about 15 centimeters, which felt like a much bigger difference than I thought. I really wanted the door to open toward the sink. If I had bought a larger one, I would have had to remove the dish drying rack, and it would have been very inconvenient because it would have gotten caught on the faucet. The fact that all four interior walls are stainless steel and that water comes out from three directions also played a part in my decision. No matter how much I looked around, I couldn't find anything with these specs at this price point. Now that I have the dishwasher, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't get one sooner. It’s almost a waste of time that I hesitated. Don't hesitate, just buy it! Your evenings will become much more relaxed.

Sentence (English): For households with typical meals, running it after one meal should suffice.
Comments (English): [ The easiest to use ] || ---------------- || *Usage Period: 1 week. *Family Composition: 2 people. *Usage Pattern: It feels wasteful to run it for just one meal, but if I combine two meals, it is just the right amount after subtracting the dishes to be washed by hand. (Breakfast is usually just yogurt and fruit. Dinner tends to be a gourmet meal, so there aren't many dishes to wash.) For households with typical meals, running it after one meal should suffice. When I am at home, I take the dishes out onto the drying rack after the wash is finished. Since the dishes are still warm, they dry quickly. Using only the door opening function takes a long time for them to dry completely because they are packed tightly together like Tetris in the narrow space of the dishwasher. It is a bit of a hassle, but since there aren't that many dishes anyway, I move them around one more time to prevent a musty smell. If that is too much trouble, it would be better to at least open the door wide and take the basket out to dry them. *Maintenance Cost: Considering the cost per detergent tablet (200-300), it is on the expensive side compared to conventional hand-washing detergent, but considering the convenience, it is a worthwhile investment. * Areas for Improvement: I wish there had been a low-temperature mode (around 50 degrees?) so I could have cleaned the humidifier discs or washed dishes that cannot be used at high temperatures. (That’s how satisfied I am!) *Noise: Aside from the noise when draining water and about three vibrations, I didn't find it particularly loud. Since the noise occurs at specific moments rather than throughout the entire 65-minute run, I found it much quieter than I expected. (Maybe I felt that way because I was prepared for the noise due to the reviews mentioning it.) *Installation: Even though I live in a very remote area, the installation was very fast, and the technician was kind and helpful. I also purchased insurance; while it would be best if I never had to use it, I trust that the issue will be handled well since it is guaranteed by Coupang. I believe this is the best product available for those who cannot install a large dishwasher or have limited space on the countertop. I debated between this and Wash* before purchasing the Midea; if I had bought the Wash*, installing it on the countertop would have been a bit tricky. There was a difference of about 15 centimeters, which felt like a much bigger difference than I thought. I really wanted the door to open toward the sink. If I had bought a larger one, I would have had to remove the dish drying rack, and it would have been very inconvenient because it would have gotten caught on the faucet. The fact that all four interior walls are stainless steel and that water comes out from three directions also played a part in my decision. No matter how much I looked around, I couldn't find anything with these specs at this price point. Now that I have the dishwasher, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't get one sooner. It’s almost a waste of time that I hesitated. Don't hesitate, just buy it! Your evenings will become much more relaxed.

Comments (English): [ The easiest to use ] || ---------------- || *Usage Period: 1 week. *Family Composition: 2 people. *Usage Pattern: It feels wasteful to run it for just one meal, but if I combine two meals, it is just the right amount after subtracting the dishes to be washed by hand. (Breakfast is usually just yogurt and fruit. Dinner tends to be a gourmet meal, so there aren't many dishes to wash.) For households with typical meals, running it after one meal should suffice. When I am at home, I take the dishes out onto the drying rack after the wash is finished. Since the dishes are still warm, they dry quickly. Using only the door opening function takes a long time for them to dry completely because they are packed tightly together like Tetris in the narrow space of the dishwasher. It is a bit of a hassle, but since there aren't that many dishes anyway, I move them around one more time to prevent a musty smell. If that is too much trouble, it would be better to at least open the door wide and take the basket out to dry them. *Maintenance Cost: Considering the cost per detergent tablet (200-300), it is on the expensive side compared to conventional hand-washing detergent, but considering the convenience, it is a worthwhile investment. * Areas for Improvement: I wish there had been a low-temperature mode (around 50 degrees?) so I could have cleaned the humidifier discs or washed dishes that cannot be used at high temperatures. (That’s how satisfied I am!) *Noise: Aside from the noise when draining water and about three vibrations, I didn't find it particularly loud. Since the noise occurs at specific moments rather than throughout the entire 65-minute run, I found it much quieter than I expected. (Maybe I felt that way because I was prepared for the noise due to the reviews mentioning it.) *Installation: Even though I live in a very remote area, the installation was very fast, and the technician was kind and helpful. I also purchased insurance; while it would be best if I never had to use it, I trust that the issue will be handled well since it is guaranteed by Coupang. I believe this is the best product available for those who cannot install a large dishwasher or have limited space on the countertop. I debated between this and Wash* before purchasing the Midea; if I had bought the Wash*, installing it on the countertop would have been a bit tricky. When I am at home, I take the dishes out onto the drying rack after the wash is finished. Since the dishes are still warm, they dry quickly. Using only the door opening function takes a long time for them to dry completely because they are packed tightly together like Tetris in the narrow space of the dishwasher. (That’s how satisfied I am!) *Noise: Aside from the noise when draining water and about three vibrations, I didn't find it particularly loud. (Breakfast is usually just yogurt and fruit. Dinner tends to be a gourmet meal, so there aren't many dishes to wash.) For households with typical meals, running it after one meal should suffice. When I am at home, I take the dishes out onto the drying rack after the wash is finished. Since the dishes are still warm, they dry quickly. Using only the door opening function takes a long time for them to dry completely because they are packed tightly together like Tetris in the narrow space of the dishwasher. It is a bit of a hassle, but since there aren't that many dishes anyway, I move them around one more time to prevent a musty smell. If that is too much trouble, it would be better to at least open the door wide and take the basket out to dry them. *Maintenance Cost: Considering the cost per detergent tablet (200-300), it is on the expensive side compared to conventional hand-washing detergent, but considering the convenience, it is a worthwhile investment. * Areas for Improvement: I wish there had been a low-temperature mode (around 50 degrees?) so I could have cleaned the humidifier discs or washed dishes that cannot be used at high temperatures. (That’s how satisfied I am!) *Noise: Aside from the noise when draining water and about three vibrations, I didn't find it particularly loud. Since the noise occurs at specific moments rather than throughout the entire 65-minute run, I found it much quieter than I expected. (Maybe I felt that way because I was prepared for the noise due to the reviews mentioning it.) *Installation: Even though I live in a very remote area, the installation was very fast, and the technician was kind and helpful. I also purchased insurance; while it would be best if I never had to use it, I trust that the issue will be handled well since it is guaranteed by Coupang. I believe this is the best product available for those who cannot install a large dishwasher or have limited space on the countertop. I debated between this and Wash* before purchasing the Midea; if I had bought the Wash*, installing it on the countertop would have been a bit tricky. When I am at home, I take the dishes out onto the drying rack after the wash is finished. Since the dishes are still warm, they dry quickly. Using only the door opening function takes a long time for them to dry completely because they are packed tightly together like Tetris in the narrow space of the dishwasher. (That’s how satisfied I am!) *Noise: Aside from the noise when draining water and about three vibrations, I didn't find it particularly loud. Since the noise occurs at specific moments rather than throughout the entire 65-minute run, I found it much quieter than I expected. (Breakfast is usually just yogurt and fruit. Dinner tends to be a gourmet meal, so there aren't many dishes to wash.) For households with typical meals, running it after one meal should suffice. When I am at home, I take the dishes out onto the drying rack after the wash is finished. Since the dishes are still warm, they dry quickly. Using only the door opening function takes a long time for them to dry completely because they are packed tightly together like Tetris in the narrow space of the dishwasher. It is a bit of a hassle, but since there aren't that many dishes anyway, I move them around one more time to prevent a musty smell. If that is too much trouble, it would be better to at least open the door wide and take the basket out to dry them. *Maintenance Cost: Considering the cost per detergent tablet (200-300), it is on the expensive side compared to conventional hand-washing detergent, but considering the convenience, it is a worthwhile investment. * Areas for Improvement: I wish there had been a low-temperature mode (around 50 degrees?) so I could have cleaned the humidifier discs or washed dishes that cannot be used at high temperatures. (That’s how satisfied I am!) *Noise: Aside from the noise when draining water and about three vibrations, I didn't find it particularly loud. Since the noise occurs at specific moments rather than throughout the entire 65-minute run, I found it much quieter than I expected. (Maybe I felt that way because I was prepared for the noise due to the reviews mentioning it.) *Installation: Even though I live in a very remote area, the installation was very fast, and the technician was kind and helpful. I believe this is the best product available for those who cannot install a large dishwasher or have limited space on the countertop. I debated between this and Wash* before purchasing the Midea; if I had bought the Wash*, installing it on the countertop would have been a bit tricky. Comments (English): [ Hard to say it's worth the money ] || ---------------- || I moved into a house that had one of the cheapest Frigidaire dishwashers they make. It lasted about 4 years before it had issues. I got the Bosch 800 series and it is very quiet, which is probably its best feature. The app seemed stupid to me at first, but it's actually useful. There are so many settings, and there isn't a button for every setting, it's easier to use the app than stand at the machine. The reason I have this three stars is because my machine has crystal dry, which is advertised as the best drying feather available especially for plastics. I don't find the drying system to be any better than the traditional bottom heating element. Maybe Cryster fry is safer because it doesn't have the bottom heating element, but it does not dry plastics better than any other dishwasher. All items are pretty dry as long as they can be placed on their side, where water can drain, but the same would be true for a bottom heating element as well. I do like the dishwater, but it was like 1400 dollars and I really wonder if another Bosch at half the price would be just as good.

Comments (English): [ Surprised and delighted ] || ---------------- || After 25 years in 3 homes with 4 dishwashers (and a decade of apartment living prior - all with dishwashers), I felt pretty knowledgeable about what to expect from a dishwasher. A few months ago, when our nice but older Kitchen Aid developed a fatal leak, i did a bit of research, asked a few trusted friends for a reccomendation and ended up buying a Bosch 300. I'm happy to report that my previous expecations for dishwasher performance were super low - I had no idea how great a dishwasher could be. To begin, ours is very quiet, takes. about half the time of our last one to run a "normal" cycle and i still can't get over how clean the dishes come out. My wife thinks I'm crazy but I keep putting un-rinsed, scraped-off yet dried-on dirty dishes, utensils etc. in there to see if it could possibly get them clean and. it hasn't failed me yet. I also love the top utensil tray, which is so convenient for unloading since our utensil drawer is right beside. It's been a couple months now and we are still loving this diswasher. Def recommended.

Comments (English): [ Upper Front Support Bracket needed. ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher, nor its installation parts, doesn't include a new upper front support bracket. My installer had to use the bracket from our previous dishwasher, which didn't work well with the new one. This bracket is used to fasten the top-front of the dishwasher to the cabinets or wall studs on both sides of the unit. And, since we have a quartz countertop, he couldn't fasten the unit to the countertop either. To prevent this from happening again, a new metal upper front support bracket should be included with the unit. At the very least, the issue should be known by sales people who could then sell the part to customers, or make them aware of the potential issue. If the new dishwasher is not replacing an existing unit, no support bracket would be available.

Sentence (English): We purchased this dishwasher in November 2024 when Lowe's was running an installation rebate.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher - terrible rebate service ] || ---------------- || We purchased this dishwasher in November 2024 when Lowe's was running an installation rebate. We had a Bosch dishwasher that lasted nearly 20 years and we knew that we wanted another one that was very similar. This dishwasher is amazing, it is super quiet (you won't know when it is running without looking for the red light indicator). The middle rack adjusts to several different positions and you can adjust one side independently of the other side. The upper rack is perfect for utensils, spatulas, and flat items. Plenty of room on the bottom rack and loading and unloading is a breeze. I haven't been able to get the "app" to work but I don't see a real need for it. However, to be very clear, the process of getting the installation rebate was a complete nightmare. I am not sure if the system is automated or who is at fault but because I purchased from Lowe's, my thoughts are that they are the ones ultimately responsible. If I had not been determined, I would have simply given up the $169 rebate. My rebate was rejected four times and I sent nearly 10 emails. My dishwasher model was clearly indicated on the rebate form and on my receipt - this should have been an "easy" process but it became a time consuming experience. I will not base a purchase again on the rebate that is offered through Lowes. If I could rank Lowes for this experience - I would give them zero stars. Do not let a sales associate lead you to believe that getting the rebate will be an easy process. Check out other reviewer comments on other sites and you will see my experience wasn't the exception.

It's a god of cost-effectiveness product. The technician contacted me right away for the installation through Coupang Rocket (I felt once again that Coupang Rocket is really great). I highly recommend the Media 6-person dishwasher with a reasonable price and very satisfactory functions. ^^!
Comments (Original): [ 깔끔한 디자인, 미디어 갓성비 식세기 대만족! ] || ---------------- || 미디어 브랜드는 해외에 주재원으로 있을때 자주 접했던 브랜드인데 국내에서 보니 반갑네요. (세제는 식세기 전용 세제가 따로 있습니다) 세척코스가 다양하여 필요에 따라 선택하면 간편합니다. 진작 구매할껄이란 생각이 드네요.  3. 가성비  미디어가 가성비 좋은 브랜드인건 알고 있었는데 국내 대기업 가격대랑 비교하면 거의 반값이네요… 로켓으로 빠르게 온다는 점과 기사님이 무료로 진행하는 방문설치까지 고려하면 이게 맞나(?) 싶은 정도입니다.  너무 저렴해서 제품 받고나서 프레임 마감상태,  실구동 성능들을 최대한 유심히 관찰하였는데 마감상태고 매우 깔끔하고 기능역시 문제없이 작동합니다. 갓 오브 갓성비 제품입니다.  쿠팡로켓으로 설치도 기사님께서 바로 연락주시고 (쿠팡로켓이 정말 대단하다고 새삼스레 느껴지는...) 거품없는 가격, 기능도 매우 만족스러운 미디어 6인용 식기세척기 강력추천 합니다. ^^!

Comments (English): [ Clean design, media-quality dishwasher, very satisfying! ] || ---------------- || Media Brand is a brand I often encountered when I was working overseas, so I'm glad to see it in Korea. I know it as a company that focuses on OEM and ODM, and I often used Media's own brand products. So, I had experience using it, and I didn't feel any resistance to the brand. I bought it to install it for my mother at my parents' house. Washing dishes takes a long time in the housework, and my mother is old, so it's hard for her to stand for long periods of time. My parents' house doesn't usually wash a lot of dishes, so I bought a 6-person one instead of a 12-person one. The 12-person one is large in size, so you have to secure space to install it, but the 6-person one is compact in size, so it takes up less space and is easy to install, which was nice. The technician contacted me right after I bought it and set up a schedule, and the installation was easy. The biggest advantage I felt was 1. Large capacity. The 6-person one didn't look that big in the picture or appearance, but when I actually used it, I could keep putting in frying pans, tumblers, and plates. The tray is not separated, and it's large and wide, so it has excellent storage capacity. 2. Convenience and time-saving are so great, I'm crazy! Just put in the detergent, press a few buttons, and you're good to go. (There is a separate detergent for dishwashers.) There are various washing courses, so it's easy to choose according to your needs. I think I should have bought it sooner. 3. Cost-effectiveness I knew Media was a good value brand, but compared to the prices of major domestic companies, it's almost half the price. Considering that it comes quickly by rocket and that the technician provides free on-site installation, I wonder if this is right (?). Because it was so cheap, I carefully observed the frame finish and actual operating performance after receiving the product, and the finish is very clean and the functions work without any problems. It's a god of cost-effectiveness product. The technician contacted me right away for the installation through Coupang Rocket (I felt once again that Coupang Rocket is really great). I highly recommend the Media 6-person dishwasher with a reasonable price and very satisfactory functions. ^^!

Sentence (English): The technician contacted me right away for the installation through Coupang Rocket (I felt once again that Coupang Rocket is really great).
Comments (English): [ Clean design, media-quality dishwasher, very satisfying! ] || ---------------- || Media Brand is a brand I often encountered when I was working overseas, so I'm glad to see it in Korea. I know it as a company that focuses on OEM and ODM, and I often used Media's own brand products. So, I had experience using it, and I didn't feel any resistance to the brand. I bought it to install it for my mother at my parents' house. Washing dishes takes a long time in the housework, and my mother is old, so it's hard for her to stand for long periods of time. My parents' house doesn't usually wash a lot of dishes, so I bought a 6-person one instead of a 12-person one. The 12-person one is large in size, so you have to secure space to install it, but the 6-person one is compact in size, so it takes up less space and is easy to install, which was nice. The technician contacted me right after I bought it and set up a schedule, and the installation was easy. The biggest advantage I felt was 1. Large capacity. The 6-person one didn't look that big in the picture or appearance, but when I actually used it, I could keep putting in frying pans, tumblers, and plates. The tray is not separated, and it's large and wide, so it has excellent storage capacity. 2. Convenience and time-saving are so great, I'm crazy! Just put in the detergent, press a few buttons, and you're good to go. (There is a separate detergent for dishwashers.) There are various washing courses, so it's easy to choose according to your needs. I think I should have bought it sooner. 3. Cost-effectiveness I knew Media was a good value brand, but compared to the prices of major domestic companies, it's almost half the price. Considering that it comes quickly by rocket and that the technician provides free on-site installation, I wonder if this is right (?). Because it was so cheap, I carefully observed the frame finish and actual operating performance after receiving the product, and the finish is very clean and the functions work without any problems. It's a god of cost-effectiveness product. The technician contacted me right away for the installation through Coupang Rocket (I felt once again that Coupang Rocket is really great). I highly recommend the Media 6-person dishwasher with a reasonable price and very satisfactory functions. ^^!

Soon afterwards I noticed a giant crack behind the handle. Still usable so I looked past it, but geeze what a flimsy piece of plastic. For such an expensive dishwasher I expected it to last longer without needing repairs.

Sentence (English): This photo speaks for itself, better than any written description or pictures.
Comments (English): This photo speaks for itself, better than any written description or pictures. First off, the size is bigger than I expected. The contents are exactly as I anticipated. You can see the grease in the photo, right? I just gave it a preliminary rinse for large food scraps and put it straight in without rubbing it with my hands. Now, here are the questions everyone is probably wondering about: 1. What is the cycle? 2. Is there no grease in the crevices or on the back of the dishes? 3. Did any of the washed-out grease run down onto other dishes or the inside? Okay, first, I ran the standard 75°C cycle (set 4) as a test, and it came out spotless. There isn't a single bit of grease inside, even in the crevices on the back of the dishes. Just to be sure, I touched the inside and checked the top and bottom surfaces, and there was none. Amazing! Today is my second day using it. The reasons I bought the 6-person size are: 1. No space for a built-in unit. 2. I prefer to run it as needed rather than stacking dishes. 3. The amount of food I use per meal is small. I bought the 6-person size for these reasons, and it is definitely fantastic. Everyone says the larger size is better, but the 6-person size is perfect for me. I picked this one specifically for the automatic door opening feature. The door stayed open, and when I checked a few hours later, everything was fully dry. As for downsides... well, I heard that leaks can occur after connecting the water supply, so I'm a bit worried and check to see if the tissues are wet after use. Also, just a slight regret about why I didn't buy it sooner. It really is awesome! Having a dishwasher means I don't have to stand around for long, which is great! Sentence (English): We're happy with the dishwasher so far; it's quiet and fits all the pots and dishes for a family of four without any problems.
Comments (English): [ Good dishwasher, quiet and spacious ] || ---------------- || We're happy with the dishwasher so far; it's quiet and fits all the pots and dishes for a family of four without any problems. The Bosch Home program tells you the status of the appliance, the scheduled wash, and when it's finished. One drawback is that we're very used to the cutlery basket; the top tray is somewhat awkward and less quick to load. It's also a bit odd when the wash cycle ends in eco mode and the door opens automatically. We're testing several programs, and in eco mode, if you put in plastic Tupperware, they don't come out very dry, but everything does come out very clean.
Comments (Original): [ Buen lavavajillas, silencioso y amplio ] || ---------------- || Estamos contentos con el lavavajillas por ahora, es silencioso, y caben todas las cazuelas y platos de una familia de 4 personas sin problemas. El programa home bosch te indica el estado del dispositivo, el lavado programado y cuando finaliza. Por ponerle algún 'pero', estamos muy acostumbrados a la cesta de los cubiertos, la bandeja de los superior es algo incómoda, menos 'rápida' de colocar. También es algo 'raro' cuando termina el ciclo de lavado, en el modo eco, y abre sola la puerta. Estamos probando varios programas, y en el modo eco, si introduces tuppers, de plástico, no salen muy secos, pero eso si, sale todo muy limpio.

BUT the next day when I went to open the app, it was no longer conncected and I cannot get it connected again. I DO NOT WANT TO OPERATE MY DISHWASHER FROM MY PHONE. 2) The inside of the dishwasher is much smaller than my old one, even though it is the same size outside. My regular-sized dinner plates standing upright hit the spray arm, so the dishes do not get clean. I have to put the plates every other slot and tilt them so they don't hit the spray arm. This means I end up running the dishwasher half full. 3) The particles on the dishes start to smell bad even after one day, so I have to run the dishwasher every. singe. day. I think it is because the instruction say to NOT rinse the dishes befor loading and the door is totally airtight. I tried adjusting the middle rack up, but then my regular-sized drinking glasses won't fit. 4) The touchpad is super-sensitive and most times it takes several attempts to get the dishwater started. 5) The forks, knives, and spoons on the top rack (3rd) rack do not always get clean. They have to be positioned 'just so' to ensure they aren't touching any other pieces or the plastic spikes that hold them in place. In fact, EVERYTHING must be postioned perfectly or the dishes do not get clean. 6) The placement of the spikes that hold plates and bowls up is really odd, so it doesn't work with any of my bowls. 7) For a high-end, high-priced appliance, the racks inside are extrement flimsy plastic. 8) I hate that the controls on my model are on the top of the door. I assume this is meant to make the dishwasher look more sleek, but it is totally impractical. There is nothing to show what stage of the wash/rinse/dray cycle is happening, and no way to pause or stop the dishwasher mid-cylce except opening the door (all the water will come out onto the floor). 9) The dish detergent leave a detergent smell on all the dishes, even though I have rinse-aid in the rinse-aid dispenser. If I could return it, I certainly would.

Sentence (English): I am very satisfied with the product, needless to say.
Comments (English): I am very satisfied with the product, needless to say. I have never filled it up, but I put it in with some room to spare, and it washes well with a 10-gram tablet detergent. In fact, I hate it when food scraps dry, so I wash the larvae roughly and then put them in. But for me, who hates washing spoons, it saves a lot of time. I have a family of three with a baby, so I usually use the upper speed sometimes and the automatic 2-hour mode a lot. I thought it would take a long time, but the 2 hours flew by in an instant. I can't help but praise the installer. He was kind and thorough. He said that the wood grain would come off if the automatic opening steamed it, so he treated it with silicone tape. Great sense!
Comments (Original): 제품은 두말할 필요도없이 너무 만족해요. 빼곡히 넣어본적은 없고 여유있게 정렬시켜 돌리니 10그람 타블릿 세제로 잘 닦여요. 사실 음식물 찌꺼기까지 건조되는게 싫어서 애벌 설겆이 대충은 하고 넣어요. 그래도 수저 설겆이 싫어하는 저에겐 시간을 많이 아껴줘요. 영유아 있는 3인가족이라 보통 상단급속 가끔쓰고 자동 2시간짜리 많이 써요. 오래걸리는줄 알았는데 어느새 흘러가있는 2시간이더군요. 설치기사님 칭찬을 안할수가 없네요. 친절하고 꼼꼼하세요. 우드가구장이라고 자동 열림으로 스팀 쐬면 나무결 벌어진다고 실리콘 테이프로 처리해주셨어요. 센스굳!!!

Comments (English): [ Great but not perfect ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) We had the same model that was approximately 12 years older that needed replacing. The fact the other Bosch was that old and performed countless cycles, always leaving our dishes clean is what led us to purchase another Bosch. The PROS: the installation was easy to follow. The fit and finish is what I've come to expect from Bosch. While the physical buttons are gone, the touch sensors work well. I like the WiFi feature that notifies you when the cycle is complete and other useful information. The top third rack is also a nice touch. The operation is quieter than our last unit. CONS: The fact you need to purchase additional parts to complete the install is ridiculous. Most kitchens likely don't have an electrical outlet to plug in the unit, at least mine didn't. It should be an option when you purchase the unit; but I digress. The bottom and middle rack design changes can't seem to accommodate our mugs, pots, glasses, etc. The tines are spaced closely together that nothing fits properly. I never had this problem with the previous unit. The included basket is tiny, which I am assuming was an intended design to force you to use the third rack for cutlery. I admit that the third rack idea is efficient in cleaning, but the rack does not operate smoothly. I always comes off the track, and doesn't close as nice as I would expect. I would have preferred a larger basket to be honest. There are also fewer options when cleaning compared to my older unit. And last, the dishes are not as dry unless you use a drying agent. With the last unit the dishes were always dry even without Jetdry. Overall the unit is good, but not perfect. I'm just hoping we get 12 years like the last dishwasher.

I like the WiFi feature that notifies you when the cycle is complete and other useful information. The top third rack is also a nice touch. The operation is quieter than our last unit. CONS: The fact you need to purchase additional parts to complete the install is ridiculous. Most kitchens likely don't have an electrical outlet to plug in the unit, at least mine didn't. It should be an option when you purchase the unit; but I digress. The bottom and middle rack design changes can't seem to accommodate our mugs, pots, glasses, etc. The tines are spaced closely together that nothing fits properly. I never had this problem with the previous unit. The included basket is tiny, which I am assuming was an intended design to force you to use the third rack for cutlery. I admit that the third rack idea is efficient in cleaning, but the rack does not operate smoothly. I always comes off the track, and doesn't close as nice as I would expect. I would have preferred a larger basket to be honest. There are also fewer options when cleaning compared to my older unit. And last, the dishes are not as dry unless you use a drying agent. With the last unit the dishes were always dry even without Jetdry. Overall the unit is good, but not perfect. I'm just hoping we get 12 years like the last dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I normally wouldn't write a review about a defective product, but it seems like this is a common issue with this dishwasher and there is no resolution.
Comments (English): [ Defective out of the box, costing us hundreds ] || ---------------- || I normally wouldn't write a review about a defective product, but it seems like this is a common issue with this dishwasher and there is no resolution. We bought this dishwasher with an entire Samsung kitchen package about 6 months ago. After running the dishwasher for a bit, we noticed that it was leaking. We contacted Samsung to make a claim under the warranty. Samsung sent a service repair person out to look at it but it didnt leak when they were here and they advised us to get a video. We finally were able to get a video of the leak so Samsung sent the service tech back out with a new seal. He spent several hours here and replaced the seal. The leak was still happening. The service tech called Samsung and they told him he wasn't supposed to replace anything and they were going to contact us for next steps. Several days later, we finally hear from Samsung that they want to replace the door and other parts. We wait again for the parts to come in and the service tech to come out. Again, he spends several hours here making repairs only for it to continue to leak. Finally Samsung agrees that its defective and they will proceed with a replacement. Unfortunately they aren't actually offering a replacement, only a refund for the price on the receipt. Because we purchased the dishwasher in a Samsung bundle, we are expected to now pay extra for the exact same product. Sentence (English): After a few weeks with our new Bosch Series 6 dishwasher, we're generally pleased with its performance, though it's taken some getting used to.
Comments (English): [ A Solid Performer with Minor Quirks ] || ---------------- || After a few weeks with our new Bosch Series 6 dishwasher, we're generally pleased with its performance, though it's taken some getting used to. One of the standout features is its water efficiency, using a mere 11 liters per load, which is a significant plus for both our water bill and the environment. Its energy efficiency is also commendable, aligning with our desire for sustainable appliances. The cleaning performance is excellent, particularly noticeable with the top cutlery drawer. Dishes come out sparkling, and we appreciate the option of using the traditional cutlery basket for added flexibility. The Wi-Fi connectivity is a welcome addition, and we're looking forward to exploring its features, especially for optimizing usage with our solar power system. However, there are a few areas where the dishwasher could be improved. The touch-sensitive buttons on the display are a bit too sensitive. As our dishwasher is installed directly beneath our stove, we frequently find ourselves accidentally changing settings while cooking, which is a minor but persistent annoyance. Another point of consideration is the design of the top basket. We've noticed that water tends to pool in mugs and cups with recessed bases, likely due to the basket's angle. A slightly steeper angle could potentially resolve this issue. We're also adjusting to the dishwasher's capacity. While it's a standard size, it feels slightly smaller than our previous model. This is likely just a matter of getting used to the different layout. Despite these minor frustrations, the Bosch Series 6 is a reliable and efficient dishwasher. It cleans effectively, is water and energy-efficient, and offers modern features like Wi-Fi connectivity. For its price point, it delivers good value for money. Overall Rating: 7.5/10

Sentence (English): I research the heck out of every purchase I make.
Comments (English): [ Best Dishwasher bar none ] || ---------------- || I research the heck out of every purchase I make. About 10 years ago I selected a Bosch dishwasher and was super happy with it, very quiet cleaned pretty well. I had replaced a couple parts after 8 years of running it. This last time I found the part I needed to replace is a bottom seal. Since it has been ten years my wife and I decided it might be time to just replace it since I had to take the whole dishwasher out and remove the whole bottom unit. Again I researched dishwashers and really the only thing close to Bosch was Miele but after my experience with Bosch we decided to stick with it. We ended up getting a Benchmark series and I am so glad I did. I thought our previous Bosch dishwasher was quiet but this new one you don't hear unless you are right next to it and there is no other noise. Very nice when your living room is right next to the kitchen! Also this thing gets dishes so much more clean then my previous Bosch. I love the smart connection and the notifications for any type of maintenance or cleaning. I can not recommend it highly enough!

Sentence (English): I had to get the top of the line Bosch because I need a built in water softener.
Comments (English): [ No gentle cycle and needs too much salt ] || ---------------- || I had to get the top of the line Bosch because I need a built in water softener. I figured it would have all the cycles you would want considering it is twice the price of a regular dishwasher. Unfortunately, there is absolutely no gentle cycle. The best you can do is put it on the 60 minute cycle instead of the regular 2+ hour cycle. I am so disappointed. How could Bosch not realize that people have stemware, plastic items, water bottles, baby items, china, silver, crystal, etc. Clearly they need more people on the design team who actually do the dishes at their home. Or at least take a survey of moms, right? Also I set my dishwasher salt setting according to my local water company's report of hardness, and I have to replace the salt EVERY 6 DAYS. Every dishwasher guy on YouTube says you should only have to do it about monthly if even that often. So I spent a fortune on the dishwasher and I am spending another fortune on the salt. I have major buyer's remorse. Also the utensil basket is a joke (wells are too shallow and too wide to properly hold utensils upright, and the lid has slots that only fit chopsticks not actual utensils), and tines on the bottom rack are angled so that you have to follow one pattern rather than be able to put dishes however you want. Also the manual doesn't have instructions on everything. it doesn't tell you what the alert with two rectangles means (I had to google it) it doesn't tell you what cleaning is recommended, etc. I do not want to have to search on my own and watch multiple videos to find simple things like that.

Sentence (English): Very disappointed in this purchase.
Comments (English): Very disappointed in this purchase. Would return if it didn't mean dishing out more money. My previous dishwasher was GE Energy Star and I really liked it, until it suddenly stopped working 4 years later. The plumber who removed it said the engine had fallen out :( The price to fix it was going to be almost as much as a new dishwasher, so I bought a new GE. It too is Energy Star, but all the dishes and silverware are still wet after wash & dry, even with the Dry Boost and dishwasher aid. I might as well wash them by hand if I still have to manually dry them. The old washer got everything dry even without rinse aid. Also the second rack does not pull all the way out! So it is hardly useable because I struggle to reach in and put dishes in half of the rack. Forget about putting anything tall in the back. I thought it was weird because the delivery person wanted to take the dishwasher to the kitchen "because it could leak water since they ran it to make sure it worked." What? Why would it not be working? It made me wonder if it is a refurbished dishwasher. I had him leave it in the foyer because I was not ready for kitchen installation. I believe this will be my last GE purchase, although all my previous appliances have been GE and still working after many years.

I read that no new Bosch's let you set delay on machine. This one you can. You don't need the app. The app gives you some more fine control of things, but you can run the machine great without it.The manual says Auto cycle is the best. That's all I've used and everything comes out perfect. This model uses a 3 pronged plug, not hardwired. Be careful of Bosch junction box sold to adapt to hardwired circuits. Sentence (English): What stands out about the LG DF355FW dishwasher is its large capacity and modularity (the three racks, the two upper ones, can be adjusted in height, and it has several fixings/positions to hold different pieces of crockery).
Comments (English): [ Good washes and better drying ] || ---------------- || What stands out about the LG DF355FW dishwasher is its large capacity and modularity (the three racks, the two upper ones, can be adjusted in height, and it has several fixings/positions to hold different pieces of crockery). Other aspects that have also convinced me are its silence during the wash cycle (and that's even though I haven't even added a cloth and two rubber strips that further reduce the noise) and the ease of use to select the desired program, indicating the remaining time at all times. Comments (English): [ In a class by itself ] || ---------------- || We purchased this dishwasher as a second choice when the installer informed us that the Bosch 800 we had originally purchased would not fit in our cabinet. We've now had it a couple months and could not be more satisfied. It consistently cleans everything, even the worst baked on crud. The steam function seems to help, I'm not sure, but I can tell you that this thing really really cleans everything. There is never a bit or a speck left on anything after the cycle finishes and everything is dry. We run the machine at the end of the day and use the night dry function, and as I said everything comes out dry. Haven't had a reason to try the dry boost function. To sum up, I don't know if the Bosch we couldn't get would have been better or even as good, but this dishwasher is (two months in) better than any of the Maytag, Whirlpool, or Kenmore machines we've had in the past by a huge margin. It appears to be very well built and I expect we'll be using it happily for a good while.

Eventually I fixed it myself and how to run it by watching YouTube videos. It's pretty noisy and can take a long time on regular cycles but again I can't compare it since it is our first one. Now that it's running well I can say it does a good job and we're happy with it but it was unnecessarily complicated.

Sentence (English): Life changing to have a dish washer.
Comments (English): Life changing to have a dish washer. Unit is small enough to fit in my small kitchen, light enough to easily move to the sink. Sparkling clean dishes whether I use an expensive name brand pod, or cheap powder. The under an hour wash cleans everything perfectly, and as long as I open the door when the wash is first done, the dishes dry quickly. When the unit arrives you will need to attach the wheels yourself. The faucet converter that came with the machine did not fit my sink, but home depot sold the converter I needed for only a few dollars. I have had no issue with the dish washer, it works even better then I had hoped.

Sentence (English): There is a design flaw with these compact machines that I didn't even consider until I owned one, and that is the shape of the machine itself.
Comments (English): [ Sprayer arms ] || ---------------- || There is a design flaw with these compact machines that I didn't even consider until I owned one, and that is the shape of the machine itself. Standard dishwashers are square with centered sprayer arms, which distributes water evenly throughout the machine. However, sprayer arms in a rectangular machine are only the width of the interior, leaving huge gaps in the front and rear, and that seriously compromises its cleaning capability. Utensils are the absolute worst because the basket sits near the door. I wonder if the dishwasher sprayed water through the sides instead of through the sprayer arms would help with this inherent handicap.

Sentence (English): This is a review after one month of use.
Comments (English): [ #BestChoiceOfMyLife #GuardianOfFamilyPeace #SatisfactoryCleaningPower #NoDrilling ] || ---------------- || This is a review after one month of use. I have used it every single day for a month, and I wonder why I waited so long to buy it. You should always think about it quickly; the sooner you buy something, the better your life will be. We are a newlywed couple of two. When we first got married and were furnishing our home, we put off buying a dishwasher because we thought, "How much cooking could the two of us possibly do?" Then, as we lived together, we wondered, "Hmm, will it work well?" and delayed it even longer. That turned out to be the worst mistake we made during our wedding preparations. We decided to buy a dishwasher. After deciding on a self-installing, 6-place setting model, we searched for information here and there. We decided on this product after watching a video by a famous review YouTuber. In conclusion, we are satisfied with its cleaning power and every other aspect. Since we live in an LH Happy Housing unit for newlyweds, our kitchen space isn't very large. We simply placed it on the floor with only three legs resting on it. They said installation could be done without drilling, so we proceeded without drilling. We cook home-cooked dinners every day, and we tend to prepare a wide variety of dishes, including those cooked with oil, chili oil, steamed dishes, and fried foods. Whether I fry pork cutlets or grill pork belly, it cleans up squeaky clean without a single trace of grease. It cleans well even when cooking stews that require long simmering times. As long as I do a pre-wash after meals, there has practically never been a single instance where the cleaning was insufficient or left undone. Since there is absolutely no maintenance required for the dishwasher itself, it is incredibly convenient. One of the reasons I hesitated to use a dishwasher was the worry that cleaning it might end up being more difficult than washing dishes. However, with a dishwasher, you simply take out the round part inside and rinse it thoroughly with water, and that's it. There is really nothing else to do. I was a bit skeptical when I was told this during installation, but it really is true. Pre-washing is mandatory, but that applies to all dishwashers. You might think, "If I have to pre-wash, isn't that just the same as hand-washing?" But no, it really isn't. My family is the type to clean up exactly what we need for one meal. Just the tableware and cooking utensils used for one meal for two people... (Usually rice + main side dish + 1 other item). It fills up completely when you put it in. It just fits a few extra cups or small plates. You can think of it as running it once for every meal. If you are looking for a 6-person, no-drill, installable model, you don't need to look for anything else; just buy this. Buy happiness for 300,000 won. Seriously, my back doesn't hurt, and I have free time. Usually, when we had dinner after work, one person would rest while the other was stuck doing the dishes. But now, eating together and relaxing while watching TV after we finish is just so wonderful. For 300,000 won, I gained a life with evenings free. It's seriously the best.

Sentence (English): You're probably tired of all these reviews about installation, but here's what I wish I knew before buying from Costco: this "free" installation service is a loss-leader business model for the companies Costco contracts with.
Comments (English): [ Be sure to understand the delivery business model ] || ---------------- || You're probably tired of all these reviews about installation, but here's what I wish I knew before buying from Costco: this "free" installation service is a loss-leader business model for the companies Costco contracts with. They will hunt for any issues they can find and claim they can't install because those issues violate building codes. Then, they'll offer to fix them for you at an increased cost, or they won't continue the installation that day. In our case, we made them come back while we looked into their list of problems. It turned out that only 1 item was real, per a licensed electrician and then the delivery company's own supervisors. Then when the installer came back, he found a "new" issue with the very same components he'd inspected before and wanted to be paid to fix it. At this point, I paid the fee simply because I wanted him out of the house. Bottom line: if you are buying for new construction or are well-versed enough in building codes and home maintenance, maybe you'd be fine buying from Costco. In all other cases, be aware that the "free" installers are going to find reasons to charge you and budget accordingly.

Sentence (English): I recently purchased a Bosch dishwasher and after several uses I can say that it has been a great choice.
Comments (English): [ Quality product ] || ---------------- || I recently purchased a Bosch dishwasher and after several uses I can say that it has been a great choice. Another thing that has surprised me is how well it dries dishes, even plastic ones, which in other models tend to be left with drops of water. The distribution of the interior space is very practical, allowing you to adjust the height of the upper tray to accommodate larger items on the lower part. Overall, I am very satisfied with the purchase. It is efficient, quiet and leaves the dishes spotless. Totally recommended!

Además, tiene varias opciones de lavado que se adaptan a diferentes niveles de suciedad, y el programa eco realmente optimiza el consumo de agua y energía.Otra cosa que me ha sorprendido es lo bien que seca los platos, incluso los de plástico, que en otros modelos suelen quedar con gotas de agua. Sentence (English): I originally used a 6-person model and then changed it.
Comments (English): [ What was life like without a dishwasher? ] || ---------------- || I originally used a 6-person model and then changed it. First of all, I am very satisfied with the large capacity and the fact that I can use all the chopsticks. It is very convenient to wash the dishes when I have guests. Since I only have to wash the first dish, I wonder if my quality of life can get any better. There is almost no noise. However, it is difficult to clean every nook and cranny as much as when washing dishes by hand. Also, if you stack too many Tetris, the dishwashing quality will drop. You should keep in mind that this model does not have a hot air dryer. I don't mind, but my husband, who wants it completely dry, leaves the dishwasher wide open. They did a great job on the installation date I wanted, and I am grateful that they are using it without any problems.
Comments (Original): [ 식기세척기 없는 삶이 어땠었죠? ] || ---------------- || 본래 6인용 쓰다가 바꿨어요.일단 대용량에, 숫가락 젓가락 다 쓴다는 점에서 대 만족입니다. 손님 맞이 한번 정도는 너무 수월하게 설거지 할 수 있어 좋습니다. 애벌 설거지만 하면 되니 이 이상 삶의 질이 좋아 질 수 있을까 싶네요. 소음도 거의 없다시피하네요.다만 손 설거지 만큼 구석구석 깨끗이는 아무래도 어렵더라고요. 그리고 너무 테트리스 많이 쌓아도 설거지 퀄리티가 떨어지고요. 열풍건조 없는 모델임은 감안해셔야 합니다. 전 상관없는데 바짝 건조 원하는 남편은 식세기를 활짝활짝 열어두네요 ㅎㅎ설치 원하는 날짜에 너무 잘해주셨고 이상 없이 잘 쓰고 있어 감사할뿐입니다

Comments (English): [ Like a BOSCH! ] || ---------------- || So, I've had this dishwasher now for about a month. When my 17 year old GE Profile finally died, I had to re-educate myself on today's modern dishwashers with all the features. Let me just say that I'm a 55 year old creature of habit who easily loyal to reliability. Within the first week of purschase, I got the dreaded error code that the filter/water line was most likely blocked. I had run one load successfully but the next 3 times I kept getting this error. After trying all the things Bosch recommened, to no avail, I contacted Home Depot to set up for repair. In my boredom, I YouTubed some videos and found one that recommended letting some vinegar sit for a bit in the filter area and then run again. I also found a women on YouTube who talked about having trouble with her Bosch until she finally decided to actually read and follow the instructions! So, I took a stab at it as well. I found that my trouble was not with the dishwasher, rather with my stubborness on assuming "how hard can it be" to simply load and go? Well, needless to say, my dishwasher has not given me any issues since! I ABOLUTELY LOVE how clean my dishes AND pots and pans are with this dishwasher. My first Bosch appliance and I'm sincerely impressed! From the "Crystal Dry" to the individual quandrant control for the bottom rack, to the top (3rd) rack. LOVE it! Really wish I had taken more pictures! I've never put pots and pans in the dishwasher due to the "rainbow" effect it had on my stainless steel pots. No longer! Now I'm off to shop for a new microwave since my current one is due to be replaced! Think I'll start with Bosch!

Since it's an object collection, the design is definitely stylish, and it goes well with other kitchen appliances, so my parents really liked this part. It's on a whole other level than hand washing! My parents didn't have high expectations for the dishwasher, but they were completely surprised when they first used it. They were amazed when they saw all the grease removed and the glass cups sparkling, and said, 'I won't have to wash dishes by hand anymore!' In particular, I occasionally put things like pots and frying pans in it, and my parents were very satisfied because it was washed so cleanly without having to scrub it hard. It is quiet, so I can use it at night without any worries! I used to hear that dishwashers were noisy, but this product is really quiet! My parents can use it at night without any worries because there is no annoying noise even when I run it late at night. They were really satisfied because it was so quiet that I wondered, "Is it really running?" while watching TV in the living room. The installation service was also friendly and good! I was a little worried because I actually searched for the lowest price on Coupang, but I didn't have to worry at all. I waited about a month for the installation, but this is because the product is so popular that they were reproducing it, and it usually happens quickly. And my parents were impressed by the kindness of the LG technicians when installing it. They explained the usage in detail and told me to contact them anytime if there was any inconvenience, so they trusted me. Thanks to that, my parents got used to it right away and are now using it very skillfully. I highly recommend it as a gift for your parents! This is the perfect gift for parents who have a hard time washing dishes! The luxurious design brightens the kitchen atmosphere! The best cleaning power! It washes thoroughly without grease or stains! It is quiet, so you can use it at night without any worries! The friendly installation service also increases satisfaction! My parents said that they are now free from the stress of washing dishes, so I feel so good too. Thanks to this, I think I can now go eat my mom's cooking comfortably. If you are thinking of a practical gift for your parents, I highly recommend this dishwasher! It is the perfect gift for filial piety.

Comments (English): [ My parents were very satisfied. I highly recommend it! ] || ---------------- || My parents had a hard time doing dishes, so I bought them a dishwasher as a gift this time. They originally said that hand washing was the best and that they didn't trust machines, so I pushed them to do it. And the result? A total success! At first, they were upset that they didn't need this, but when they saw the results of the dishes they washed, they were so satisfied that I was proud of them. The clean design and the kitchen interior were perfect! First of all, the nature beige color was luxurious, so the kitchen felt bright and sophisticated. Since it's an object collection, the design is definitely stylish, and it goes well with other kitchen appliances, so my parents really liked this part. Since it's a built-in product, I installed it right on the existing sink, and I was so satisfied with how neatly it was organized, as if it was there all along. The cleaning power is the best! It's on a whole other level than hand washing! My parents didn't have high expectations for the dishwasher, but they were completely surprised when they first used it. They were amazed when they saw all the grease removed and the glass cups sparkling, and said, 'I won't have to wash dishes by hand anymore!' In particular, I occasionally put things like pots and frying pans in it, and my parents were very satisfied because it was washed so cleanly without having to scrub it hard. It is quiet, so I can use it at night without any worries! I used to hear that dishwashers were noisy, but this product is really quiet! My parents can use it at night without any worries because there is no annoying noise even when I run it late at night. They were really satisfied because it was so quiet that I wondered, "Is it really running?" while watching TV in the living room. The installation service was also friendly and good! I was a little worried because I actually searched for the lowest price on Coupang, but I didn't have to worry at all. I waited about a month for the installation, but this is because the product is so popular that they were reproducing it, and it usually happens quickly. And my parents were impressed by the kindness of the LG technicians when installing it. They explained the usage in detail and told me to contact them anytime if there was any inconvenience, so they trusted me. Thanks to that, my parents got used to it right away and are now using it very skillfully. I highly recommend it as a gift for your parents! This is the perfect gift for parents who have a hard time washing dishes! The luxurious design brightens the kitchen atmosphere! The best cleaning power! It washes thoroughly without grease or stains! It is quiet, so you can use it at night without any worries! The friendly installation service also increases satisfaction! My parents said that they are now free from the stress of washing dishes, so I feel so good too. Thanks to this, I think I can now go eat my mom's cooking comfortably. If you are thinking of a practical gift for your parents, I highly recommend this dishwasher! It is the perfect gift for filial piety.

Since it's an object collection, the design is definitely stylish, and it goes well with other kitchen appliances, so my parents really liked this part. Since it's a built-in product, I installed it right on the existing sink, and I was so satisfied with how neatly it was organized, as if it was there all along. The cleaning power is the best! It's on a whole other level than hand washing! My parents didn't have high expectations for the dishwasher, but they were completely surprised when they first used it. They were amazed when they saw all the grease removed and the glass cups sparkling, and said, 'I won't have to wash dishes by hand anymore!' In particular, I occasionally put things like pots and frying pans in it, and my parents were very satisfied because it was washed so cleanly without having to scrub it hard. It is quiet, so I can use it at night without any worries! I used to hear that dishwashers were noisy, but this product is really quiet! My parents can use it at night without any worries because there is no annoying noise even when I run it late at night. They were really satisfied because it was so quiet that I wondered, "Is it really running?" while watching TV in the living room. The installation service was also friendly and good! I was a little worried because I actually searched for the lowest price on Coupang, but I didn't have to worry at all. I waited about a month for the installation, but this is because the product is so popular that they were reproducing it, and it usually happens quickly. And my parents were impressed by the kindness of the LG technicians when installing it. They explained the usage in detail and told me to contact them anytime if there was any inconvenience, so they trusted me. Thanks to that, my parents got used to it right away and are now using it very skillfully. I highly recommend it as a gift for your parents! This is the perfect gift for parents who have a hard time washing dishes! The luxurious design brightens the kitchen atmosphere! The best cleaning power! It washes thoroughly without grease or stains! It is quiet, so you can use it at night without any worries! The friendly installation service also increases satisfaction! My parents said that they are now free from the stress of washing dishes, so I feel so good too. Thanks to this, I think I can now go eat my mom's cooking comfortably. If you are thinking of a practical gift for your parents, I highly recommend this dishwasher! It is the perfect gift for filial piety.

Sentence (English): I bought a Minix dishwasher with my own money!

Sentence (English): Please note that this review is being written within about 1 month of installation.
Comments (English): [ Early days, but I'd definitely recommend ] || ---------------- || Please note that this review is being written within about 1 month of installation. I don't have a good idea how this machine will fare over time. That being said, I've found this dishwasher to be of good quality and would recommend it. it cleans the dishes very well, and dries them acceptably (better than my last Maytag). It is fairly quiet, and the controls are simple and easily accessible. And the appliance does NOT require connection to my wifi. That last item is a big plus for a number of reasons. It receives 4 stars instead of 5 for two small reasons. First, when it arrived the rear of the dishwasher's stainless steel tub (where no one can see it) was dented. Typically that's a shipping problem, but in this case the box was not dented, and I suspect that the appliance was dented at the factory. When I found the dent I was in the middle of the installation process and certainly didn't want to wait 2 weeks for a new machine, so I installed it. My wife has not noticed, and likely never will, so we're good to go. Second, like a lot of high efficiency appliances this dishwasher is slow. The normal cycle with the heated dry takes nearly three hours. That's a long time, Maytag--seriously. But since I typically start it in the morning as I'm heading to work, or in the evening as I'm heading to bed, it's not much of a practical issue.

I was assured by 3 different people by email that a senior team would be sent out to remove the dishwasher so it could be repaired.One day before the fourth team was scheduled, I received an email from Costco Resoutions that no one would be coming out and nothing else would be done. After 4 weeks of washing dishes by hand, no dishwasher and the only option offered by Costco was to return it for a refund.Needless, I will not be purchasing any appliances from Costco that need anything more than delivery and plug in.

Comments (English): [ I love this machine more than any other I've owned ] || ---------------- || I love this dishwasher! I have owned this model of dishwasher three times. The first was in a house I sold, the second broke down (due to something that was my own fault), and this one.I initially replaced the 2nd one with a Bosch and hated it! The features that made the difference were:1) The third rack allows so many more dishes. When you no longer have to put glasses in the main part of the D/W, it frees up so much space for regular dishes. All other brands have a flat 3rd rack that is not all that helpful.2) The silverware basket is large. Bosch tries to force you to load the silverware in the upper rack, which is not intuitive. The silverware basket was about 1/3 the size of this machine.3) The tines are straight up and down. That is the configuration of most dishwashers. The Bosch tines are all on a slant, which requires learning to load every dish differently. Again, they are forcing you to load the machine in a way that is not intuitive.4) The control panel shows the progression of the cycle. While it would be nice to see an actual countdown of minutes left in the cycle, at least I can see the general idea of where it is in the cycle.5) It is easy to see the cycle selection. The Bosch has to be programmed with an app. The most basic functions were button-controlled, but accessing any special wash cycles or features (including "pause") requires the app.I like are that it is quiet. I bought the model without a handle an much prefer it. Not only is the control panel visible, but it prevents the bruised thighs when you bump that handle! One thing I would improve: there is a dead zone in the middle of the bottom spray arm that is 7" long. Most dishes are loaded in such a way that it doesn't matter - the water from the jets splashes enough to hit them. But I put a dirty drinking cup in the middle of that rack and it got absolutely NO water to it. There should be holes (jets) closer to the middle of that arm.I am also somewhat concerned about the longevity of this machine. While some of the failures of my previous machine were my fault (I had my hot water temp too high, which melted some plastic parts), there were additional problems that weren't caused by that.Even so, I love this so much I was willing to risk it breaking down sooner. I protected myself with an extended 5-year warranty that rivals a Bosch warranty. I truly get a happy feeling every time I use this dishwasher! I would have hated every day of using that Bosch. By the way, I bought the Bosch from Best Buy so that I had their 15 day no-questions-asked guarantee, so I was able to return it at no cost. If you have the option, I would buy it from them and pay close attention to when that grace period ends.This KitchenAid was $500 cheaper than the Bosch. So I got the KitchenAid with the extended warranty for $350 less than the Bosch.
